qe: In 1759-61, while the Nawab and the English Company were facing troubles, which Mughal prince invading Bihar and Bengal did the Dutch traders try to co-operate with?
qh: 1759-61 में जब नवाब तथा अंग्रेज कंपनी मुश्किल में थे, बंगाल तथा बिहार के डच किस मुगल शहज़ादे के साथ मिलकर चलने की कोशिश कर रहे थे, जो बिहार और बंगाल पर आक्रमण कर रहा था?
e: Bedara (1759) ki haar ke baad Dutch ki sthiti bahut kamzor ho gayi thi, isliye unhone Bangal tatha Bihar ke un sabhi logon se milkar apni khoyi hui izzat tatha vyapar wapas paane ki koshish ki, jo Nawab ki sarkar se khush nahi the. 1759 se 1761 ke beech kshetra me bahut ashanti thi: Kamgar Khan Main, jo Gaya jile ke Narhat ke zamindar the, Birbhum-Burdwan tatha Vishnupur ke raja tatha Purnea ke gavarnar Khadim Husain Khan Nawab ki sarkar ke viruddh the; Maratha sardaar Sheo Bhat Sathe pashchimi Bangal me lootpat kar raha tha tatha Mughal shehzada Shah Alam II (Ali Gohur) Bihar tatha Bangal par hamla kar raha tha. Dutch log in asantusht logon tatha us shehzade ke saath mil kar chalne lage, kyunki woh apni purani shakti tatha vyapar wapas chahte the. Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya ki woh uske khule dushmanon se gupt patra-vyavahar kar rahe the tatha Shah Alam II ki madad ka vada kar chuke the. Exam point: 1759-61 me Dutch ne Mughal shehzada Shah Alam II (Ali Gohur) ke saath milne ki koshish ki; unpar Mir Jafar ne gupt patra-vyavahar tatha madad ka ilzaam lagaya; us daur me Kamgar Khan Main, Khadim Husain Khan tatha Maratha Sheo Bhat Sathe jaise log bhi Nawab ke viruddh the.

qe: Which naib nazim of Bihar wrote to the Dutch, praising their bravery and capacity and promising that whatever they represented to the Emperor would be granted?
qh: बिहार के किस नायब नाज़िम ने डचों को पत्र लिखकर उनकी बहादुरी तथा योग्यता की प्रशंसा की तथा भरोसा दिया कि बादशाह के सामने रखी उनकी हर बात मान ली जाएगी?
e: Bedara ki haar ke baad Dutch log Bangal tatha Bihar ke asantusht logon ke saath milkar apni khoyi hui sthiti sudharne ki koshish kar rahe the. Isi silsile me Bihar ke naib nazim Rajah Ramnarain ne Dutch ko khat likha, jisme unki bahaduri tatha yogyata ki tareef ki gayi tatha kaha gaya ki jo kuch woh Mughal badshah ke saamne rakhenge, woh unhe mil jaayega; unke khat me Meer Said Ali Khan Bahadur ka bhi zikr tha, jo badshah ke darbar me the tatha Ramnarain ke mitra the. Isi tarah Shah Alam II ne bhi Dutch ko likha ki unki wafadari tatha sevaon ka zikr darbar me kiya gaya hai tatha unhe raja ki aagya maan leni chahiye. Ramnarain Bihar ke bahut prabhavshali adhikari the; aage 1763 me Mir Kasim ne unhe marwaya, jis se yeh bhi pata chalta hai ki us daur me naib nazim ki bhumika kitni mahatvapurn thi. Exam point: Bihar ke naib nazim Rajah Ramnarain ne 1759-60 ke aas-paas Dutch ko khat likh kar unki tareef ki tatha badshah se unki madad ka bharosa diya; Shah Alam II ne bhi Dutch ko isi tarah ka khat bheja; aage Mir Kasim ne Ramnarain ko marwaya.

qe: On 11 February 1760, the Nawab of Bengal sent a large army against the Dutch at Hugli under the command of which officer?
qh: 11 फरवरी 1760 को बंगाल के नवाब ने हुगली में डचों के विरुद्ध किस अफसर के नेतृत्व में बड़ी सेना भेजी?
e: Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya ki woh uske khule dushmanon se gupt sambandh rakh rahe the tatha Mughal shehzade Ali Gohur (Shah Alam II) ko madad dene ka vada kar chuke the. In aaropon ke kaaran 11 February 1760 ko Nawab ne Kasim Khan ki aguvai me ek badi sena Hugli me Dutch ke paas bheji. Kasim Khan ki sena ne Dutch Company ke kila Fort Gustavus ko is tarah gher liya ki company ke karmcharion ko khana-peena bhi nahi pahunch paaya. Usne kila ke bahari morche yaani outworks girane ka hukm diya tatha Dutch se bhaari jurmana maanga; Dutch ne khud ko nirdosh bataya, lekin unki baat nahi maani gayi tatha unhe bahari morche gira kar bhaari rakam deni padi. Is ghatna se pata chalta hai ki Bedara ke baad Dutch itne kamzor ho gaye the ki Nawab ki marzi ke bina unka ek kila bhi surakshit nahi tha. Exam point: 11 February 1760 ko Nawab Mir Jafar ne Kasim Khan ke netritva me Hugli me Dutch par sena bheji; Dutch ka kila Fort Gustavus gher liya gaya tatha unhe kila ke bahari morche girane pade; Bedara ke baad Dutch ki sthiti bahut kamzor thi.

qe: After the outworks of the Dutch fort at Hugli were razed in February 1760, how much did the Dutch pay to buy off further acts of violence?
qh: फरवरी 1760 में हुगली के डच किले के बाहरी मोर्चे गिराए जाने के बाद डचों ने आगे की हिंसा से बचने के लिए कितनी रकम दी?
e: Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya tha ki woh uske dushmanon se mil kar chal rahe the, isliye 11 February 1760 ko Kasim Khan ki aguvai me ek badi sena Hugli me Dutch ke kila Fort Gustavus par bheji gayi. Kasim Khan ne kila ke bahari morche yaani outworks girane ka hukm diya tatha Dutch se bhaari jurmana maanga. Dutch ne khud ko nirdosh batane ki bahut koshish ki, lekin unki baat nahi maani gayi; unhe kila ke bahari hisse poore gira dene pade tatha aage ki hinsa se bachne ke liye pachas hazaar florin dene pade. Florin Holland ki mudra thi, isliye yah rakam us daur ke hisaab se bahut bhaari thi; lekin Dutch ki sthiti itni kamzor ho gayi thi ki unhe yah shart maan kar apna kaam bachana pada. Exam point: February 1760 me Hugli ke Dutch kila Fort Gustavus par Kasim Khan ke hamle ke baad Dutch ne pachas hazaar florin de kar aage ki hinsa se khud ko bachaya; unhe kila ke bahari morche girane pade the; florin Holland ki mudra thi.

qe: In April 1760, accusing the Dutch of levying men, the Nawab demanded from the Company how much gold, threatening to level their settlements if it was not paid?
qh: अप्रैल 1760 में डचों पर सैनिक भर्ती करने का आरोप लगाकर नवाब ने कंपनी से कितना सोना माँगा तथा न देने पर उनकी बस्तियाँ ज़मीन से बराबर कर देने की धमकी दी?
oe: Twenty-two and a half tons of gold
Seven and a half tons of gold
e: April 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya ki woh apni company ke liye logon ko sipahi ke roop me bharti kar rahe hain. Usne Cassimbazar factory ke chief ko talab kiya, lekin woh bimaari ke kaaran nahi aa sake, isliye factory ke second adhikari De Wilde Nawab ke saamne pesh hue. Nawab ne unke saamne phir wahi ilzaam dohraya ki company ke karmchari uske dushmanon se patra-vyavahar tatha saazish kar rahe hain, tatha company se bayees-ton-se-adhi yaani two and twenty tons and a half sona maanga; saath hi dhamki di ki agar yah rakam turant na di gayi, to unki poori basti zameen se baraabar kar di jaaegi. De Wilde ne samjhaya ki company ke sipahi Maratha hamlon se bachav ke liye rakhe gaye the, lekin unki baat nahi maani gayi; Nawab ne unhe giraftar kar liya tatha Cassimbazar factory ke saamne gyarah top khadi kar di. Ant me Dutch ne apni factory ko turant tabahi se bachane ke liye saade saat ton sona diya tatha sipahiyon ko hata dene ka vada kiya. Exam point: April 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar ne Dutch company se bayees-ton-se-adhi sona (two and twenty tons and a half) maanga tatha bastiyan zameen se baraabar karne ki dhamki di; De Wilde giraftar hue tatha Cassimbazar factory ke saamne gyarah top khadi gayi; ant me Dutch ne saade saat ton sona diya.

qe: The second officer of the Dutch factory at Cassimbazar, De Wilde, was put under arrest in April 1760 on the orders of which Nawab of Bengal?
qh: कासिमबाजार की डच फैक्ट्री के दूसरे अफसर डी वाइल्ड को अप्रैल 1760 में बंगाल के किस नवाब के आदेश पर गिरफ्तार किया गया?
e: 1759 ki Bedara ladai ke baad Dutch ki halat bahut kamzor thi tatha woh angrejon tatha Nawab par nirbhar ho gaye the. 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar unhe baar-baar dosh deta raha ki woh uske dushmanon tatha Mughal shehzade Shah Alam II ke saath mil kar chal rahe hain. April 1760 me Nawab ne Cassimbazar factory ke chief ko bulaya, lekin bimaari ke kaaran woh pesh nahi ho sake, isliye factory ke second adhikari De Wilde ko Nawab ke saamne jaana pada. Nawab ne De Wilde ke saamne ilzaam laga kar unhe giraftar kar liya tatha Dutch company ki Cassimbazar factory ko apni sena se gher kar uske saamne gyarah top khadi kar di. Us samay Bangal ka Nawab Mir Jafar tha, jise angrejon ne Plassey (1757) ke baad gaddi par baithaya tha; Mir Kasim 1760 ke ant me Nawab bana tatha Alivardi Khan us se pehle ke daur ke Nawab the. Exam point: Cassimbazar factory ke second adhikari De Wilde ko April 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar ne giraftar kiya; factory ko gher kar gyarah top khadi gayi; De Wilde apne chief ke bimar hone ke kaaran pesh hue the.

qe: Among those hostile to the Nawab's government in 1759-61, Khadim Husain Khan was the governor of which district?
qh: 1759-61 में नवाब की सरकार के विरोधियों में शामिल खादिम हुसैन खान किस जिले के गवर्नर थे?
e: Bedara (1759) ke baad Dutch log Bangal tatha Bihar ke un sabhi logon se madad lene ki koshish kar rahe the, jo Nawab ki sarkar se khush nahi the. Un dino Kamgar Khan Main, jo Gaya jile ke Narhat ke zamindar the, Birbhum, Burdwan tatha Vishnupur ke raja tatha Purnea ke gavarnar Khadim Husain Khan Nawab ki sarkar ke viruddh the; isi tarah pashchimi Bangal me Maratha sardaar Sheo Bhat Sathe bhi lootpat kar raha tha. Dutch ne in sabhi asantusht logon tatha Mughal shehzade Shah Alam II ke saath milkar phir se apni izzat tatha vyapar paane ki koshish ki. Isi daur me Nawab tatha angreji Company ko bhi andaruni tatha bahari dono taraf se chunautiyan mil rahi thi, isliye unke dushmanon ko madad dene wale kisi bhi giroh se unhe khatra tha. Exam point: 1759-61 me Nawab ki sarkar ke viruddh khade logon me Purnea ke gavarnar Khadim Husain Khan, Gaya kshetra ke Narhat ke Kamgar Khan Main tatha Birbhum-Burdwan-Vishnupur ke raja shaamil the; Dutch ne in sabse milne ki koshish ki.

qe: Which Dutch fort at Hugli was invested in February 1760 so closely that the Company's servants could get no provisions of any kind?
qh: हुगली का कौन-सा डच किला फरवरी 1760 में इस तरह घेर लिया गया कि कंपनी के कर्मचारियों को किसी भी तरह का खाना-पानी नहीं मिल पाया?
e: Hugli kshetra me Dutch yaani Holland ki East India Company ka ek kila tha, jiska naam Fort Gustavus tha. 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya ki woh uske dushmanon se mil kar chal rahe hain tatha unki madad kar rahe hain; isliye 11 February 1760 ko Kasim Khan ki aguvai me ek badi sena us kila par bheji gayi. Kasim Khan ki sena ne kila ko is tarah gher liya ki company ke karmcharion ko khana-peena bhi nahi pahunch paaya tatha usne kila ke bahari morche girane ka hukm diya. Aisi ghatnaon se pata chalta hai ki Bedara ki ladai ke baad Dutch ki rajnitik tatha sainya sthiti kitni kamzor ho gayi thi, kyunki ab woh apne kile tatha vyapar ki raksha khud nahi kar paate the tatha unhe Nawab tatha angrejon ki marzi maanni padti thi. Angrejon ke anya kile Fort William tatha Fort St George alag-alag shahron me hain. Exam point: Hugli me Dutch kila Fort Gustavus tha, jise 11 February 1760 me Kasim Khan ki sena ne gher liya tatha company ke karmchari bina khane-peene ke reh gaye; isse pata chalta hai ki Bedara ke baad Dutch ki sthiti bahut kamzor ho gayi thi.

qe: In the Memorial submitted by the Dutch to the Council in Calcutta in April 1775, which articles of trade were mentioned as suffering vexations and obstructions?
qh: अप्रैल 1775 में डचों द्वारा कलकत्ता की काउंसिल को दिए स्मारक-पत्र में किन व्यापारिक वस्तुओं के व्यापार में बाधाओं का जिक्र था?
oe: Cotton cloths, saltpetre, opium, raw silk and silk stuffs
oh: सूती कपड़ा, शोरा, अफीम, कच्चा रेशम तथा रेशमी कपड़ा
e: April 1775 me Dutch logon ne Calcutta ki Council me ek Memorial yaani smarak-patra diya, jisme unhone apni pichhli atharah saalon ki shikayatein likhi thin. Is Memorial me unki shikayaton ke khaas vishay the - suti kapde, shora, afim, kachcha resham tatha reshami kapde jaise mahatvapurn vyaparik maalon ke vyapar me aari-taklifen tatha rukavatein; angreji Company ke karmchariyon ka unpar zulm; Patna me shora kharidne ke liye peshkah yaani pehle paisa dene ki majboori; sikka tatha mudra ke maamle me uljhan; Hugli ke badalte faujdaron ke saath wahan ke nivasiyon par adhikar ko lekar jhagde; tatha unke jahazon ko raste me kai chowkiyon yaani customs stations par rokne se hone wali hani. Ant me Memorial me yah prastav bhi tha ki Baranagore ki Dutch basti ko Chinasura ke aas-paas ki usi naap wali zameen ke badle badla jaaye. Aise shikayat-patra dikhate hain ki Dutch vyapar ko ek saath kai taraf se dabaav jhelna pad raha tha. Exam point: April 1775 ke Dutch Memorial me suti kapde, shora, afim, kachcha resham tatha reshami kapde ke vyapar me badhaon ka zikr tha; isme Patna me shora ke liye peshkah dene ki majboori, mudra ki uljhan tatha raste ki customs chowkiyon par jahaz rokne ki shikayat bhi thi; iske saath Baranagore ke badle Chinsura ke paas zameen lene ka prastav tha.

qe: The Dutch Memorial of April 1775 proposed the exchange of which Dutch settlement for a plot of land in the circle of Chinsura?
qh: अप्रैल 1775 के डच स्मारक-पत्र में किस डच बस्ती को चिनसुरा के क्षेत्र की जमीन से बदलने का प्रस्ताव था?
e: April 1775 ka Dutch Memorial keval shikayaton ka patra nahi tha; usme kuch prastav bhi the. Sabse khaas prastav yah tha ki Baranagore ki Dutch basti ko Chinsura ke circle yaani aas-paas ki aisi zameen ke badle badal diya jaaye, jo naap me Baranagore ke barabar ho. Iska karan yah tha ki Baranagore me Dutch logon ka poora vyaparik kaam theek se nahi chal pa raha tha tatha Chinsura unka mukhya kendra tha, isliye unhe wahan mili-juli zameen se zyada suvidha ki aasha thi. Isi Memorial me unki baaki shikayatein bhi shamil thin - suti kapde, shora, afim tatha resham ke vyapar me rukavatein, angreji Company ke karmchariyon ka zulm tatha raste ki chowkiyon par rok-tok. Aise prastav dikhate hain ki vyaparik suvidha ke liye bastiyan badalna us daur ki aam rivaz thi. Exam point: April 1775 ke Memorial me Baranagore ki Dutch basti ko Chinsura ke circle ki barabar naap wali zameen ke badle badalne ka prastav tha; iska karan Baranagore me vyaparik dikkat tatha Chinsura ka mukhya kendra hona tha; is Memorial me vyaparik badhaon ki lambi suchi bhi thi.

qe: On which date in April 1775 were the Dutch envoys allowed to be present at the meeting of the Council in Calcutta, where they delivered their Memorial?
qh: अप्रैल 1775 की किस तारीख को डच प्रतिनिधियों को कलकत्ता की काउंसिल की बैठक में उपस्थित रहने की अनुमति मिली, जहाँ उन्होंने अपना स्मारक-पत्र सौंपा?
e: April 1775 me Dutch logon ke do pratinidhi - Van Dankelman tatha Eilbracht - Calcutta pahunche. Unhe Calcutta ki Council ki 25 April 1775 ko hui baithak me upasthit rehne ki anumati mili tatha wahin unhone apna Memorial yaani smarak-patra saunpa. Is baithak ke baad 29 April 1775 ko Calcutta ki Council ne Hugli ki Dutch Council ko apna jawab bheja. Jawab bada savdhani-bhara tha - usme kaha gaya ki Memorial ke kai anuchhedon ki jaanch ke liye door-daraz ki factories se record tatha anya dastavej mangane padenge, isliye isme samay lagega; saath hi yah bhi kaha gaya ki unka Memorial sirf samanya shikayaton ka varnan hai, usme har shikayat ka hal kis roop me chahte hain, yah saaf nahi likha hai. Isliye unse kaha gaya ki woh apni shikayatein alag-alag anuchhedon me likh kar bhejein. Aise patra-vyavahar dikhate hain ki sarkari jawab aksar tarkhana ke saath tatha deri se milta tha. Exam point: 25 April 1775 ki Calcutta Council ki baithak me Dutch pratinidhi Van Dankelman tatha Eilbracht ko upasthit hone ki anumati mili tatha unhone wahi apna Memorial saunpa; 29 April 1775 ke jawab me Council ne kaha ki record mangane me samay lagega tatha shikayatein anuchhed-war likh kar bheji jaayein.

qe: The Dutch envoys asked that orders be published in places where cloth manufacturers were established, so that their trade might be carried on in the manner directed by what?
qh: डच प्रतिनिधियों ने मांग की कि कपड़ा बनाने वालों के क्षेत्रों में आदेश प्रकाशित कराया जाये, जिससे उनका व्यापार किसके दिर्शे-निर्देशों के अनुसार चल सके?
e: Memorial saunpne ke saath-saath Dutch pratinidhiyon ne ek aur maang rakhi. Unhone 28 April 1775 ko mukhik tatha ek patra ke zariye Calcutta Council se kaha ki jahan-jahan kapde banane wale tatha anya maal banane wale log base hain, wahan turant aadesh prakashit karaye jaayein; unka aashay yah tha ki Dutch Company ka vyapar bhi angreji Company ke barabar, bina kisi rukavat ke, un firmans ke nirdeshon ke mutabik chale jo Mughal samrat ki or se unhe pehle mile the. Calcutta Council ne is par turant ek aadesh prakashit karaya tatha kaha ki yah unki maang poora karne ke liye paryapt hai; saath hi yah bhi kaha ki desh ke mukta vyapar ko nuksan pahunchane wale kisi bhi galat prayas ko rokne ke liye woh har samay unki tatha unke agenton ki shikayat sunne tatha unka nivaran karne ko tayaar hain, tatha unke rashtra ke visheshadhikaron ko har sambhav sahyog denge. Is tarah Dutch Company ko likhit aashwasan to mil gaya, lekin asli vyaparik samasyayein usse turant hal nahi hui. Exam point: Dutch pratinidhiyon ne 28 April 1775 ko maang ki ki kapde banane wale kshetron me turant aadesh prakashit kiye jaayein taaki unka vyapar Mughal samrat ke firmans ke nirdeshon ke mutabik chale; Calcutta Council ne turant aadesh prakashit karaya tatha sahyog ka aashwasan diya, lekin vyavharik samasyayein turant hal nahi hui.

qe: Before giving any opinion on the old firmans and sanads of the Dutch, what did the Council in Calcutta demand?
qh: डचों के पुराने फरमानों तथा सनदों पर कोई राय देने से पहले कलकत्ता की काउंसिल ने क्या मांगा?
oe: An undertaking not to trade in Bengal
Copies of the documents for perusal
A written promise to pay the tribute
oh: बंगाल में व्यापार न करने का वचन
दस्तावेजों की प्रतियाँ देखने के लिए
e: April 1775 ke Memorial ke baad Dutch logon ne yah cha sa ki Calcutta ki Council unke purane firmans tatha sanadon yaani adhikar-patra ko manya ghoshit kare. Is maang par Calcutta Council ne turant koi spasht raay nahi di; usne pehle yah maang ki ki un sabhi dastavejon ki pratiyan bheji jaayein, taaki unhe padh kar dekha ja sake. Yah tareeka dikhata hai ki us daur me sarkari karyapranali tatha vidhik adhikaron ka nirnay likhit pramaan ke aadhaar par hota tha, isliye aise maamlon me nirnay lene me kaafi samay lagta tha. Isi ke saath Council ne 12 June 1775 ko Patna ke apne Council ke chief Mr. Isaac Sage ko likha ki woh Patna ki Dutch factory ke shuruaati samay se ab tak ke sarkari record dekhein tatha unhe batayein ki Bihar me shora tatha afim ke vyapar me Dutch Company ko kaun-kaun se adhikar tatha suvidhaayein pehle prapt thin. Is tarah ek Memorial ne aage lambi jaanch ka raasta khol diya. Exam point: Dutch ke purane firmans tatha sanadon par raay dene se pehle Calcutta Council ne un dastavejon ki pratiyan mangi; isi ke saath Council ne 12 June 1775 ko Patna ke English Council ke chief Mr. Isaac Sage se shora tatha afim ke vyapar me Dutch adhikaron ki jaankari mangwayi.

qe: On 12 June 1775 the Council in Calcutta wrote to which chief of the English Council at Patna to consult the records from the earliest period of the Dutch factory at Patna?
qh: 12 जून 1775 को कलकत्ता की काउंसिल ने पटना स्थित अंग्रेजी काउंसिल के किस मुखिया को लिखा कि वे पटना की डच फैक्ट्री के शुरुआती समय से सरकारी रिकॉर्ड देखें?
e: Dutch Memorial ki jaanch ke silsile me Calcutta ki Council ne 12 June 1775 ko Patna ke apne Council ke chief Mr. Isaac Sage ko ek patra likha. Is patra me unhe kaha gaya ki woh Patna ki Dutch factory ke sthaapna ke shuruaati samay se ab tak ke sarkari record khol kar dekhein tatha Bihar me shora tatha afim ke vyapar me Dutch Company ko pehle jo adhikar tatha suvidhaayein prapt thin, unki sahi jaankari bhejein. Isi ke saath unse yah bhi poocha gaya ki Dutch logon dwara Bihar sarkar ko diye jaane wale nazrane ki sthiti tatha uske aarambh ke baare me jo kuch woh jaante hain, uski pura tatha sahi jaankari dein. Is tarah ek chhote se Memorial ne Patna ki Dutch factory ke poore purane record tatha nazrane ke mool ka sawal khol diya, jiska jawab dhoondhne me sarkar ko saal bhar se zyada lag sakta tha. Exam point: 12 June 1775 ko Calcutta Council ne Patna ke English Council ke chief Mr. Isaac Sage ko likha ki woh Dutch factory ke shuruaati samay se ab tak ke sarkari record dekhein tatha shora-afim ke vyaparik adhikaron tatha nazrane ke mool ki sahi jaankari bhejein.

qe: In April 1762 the Court of Directors in England ordered its Council in Calcutta not to commit any hostility against the Dutch, but to aid and defend them if which authority molested them?
qh: अप्रैल 1762 में इंग्लैंड में कोर्ट ऑफ डायरेक्टर्स ने कलकत्ता की अपनी काउंसिल को आदेश दिया कि डचों के विरुद्ध कोई शत्रुता न की जाए, बल्कि यदि कौन-सा शासक उन्हें परेशान करे तो उनकी सहायता तथा रक्षा की जाए?
e: Bedara (1759) ke baad Dutch ki sthiti kamzor ho gayi thi tatha Holland me Dutch East India Company ke directaron ne apni shikayatein rakhi thi, jiske kaaran Netherlands ke States General ne bharat ke liye sena bhejne ki taiyari shuru kar di thi. Isse bade takrao ka khatra dekh kar England ke Secretary of State Earl of Bute ne Company ke Directaron ko salah di ki woh dono deshon ke beech ke jhagde door karein. Isi salah ke aadhaar par April 1762 me Court of Directors ne Calcutta Council ko likha ki Dutch Company ke karmcharion ke viruddh koi shatruta ki karwai na ki jaye, balki unse madad-bhav rakha jaye; agar Nawab unjustly Dutch Company ko Bengal me pareshan kare ya unke vyapar tatha sampatti ko nuksan pahunchane ki koshish kare, to Company unki taraf se beech me pade tatha unhe nyay dilane me madad kare. Exam point: April 1762 me Court of Directors ne Calcutta Council ko aadesh diya ki Dutch ke viruddh koi shatruta na ho tatha agar Nawab unhe pareshan kare to unki sahayata tatha raksha ki jaye; yah nirdesh Earl of Bute ki salah par diya gaya tha.

qe: The English East India Company established a monopoly of the manufacture and trade of which article in Bihar in 1761?
qh: अंग्रेज ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी ने 1761 में बिहार में किस वस्तु के निर्माण तथा व्यापार पर एकाधिकार स्थापित कर लिया था?
e: 1761 me angrej East India Company ne Bihar me afim ke nirman tatha vyapar par ekadhikar yaani monopoly sthapna kar liya, jiske baad anya European companies ko is vastu ki sirf seemit matra hi kharidne ki anumati di gayi. Afim (opium) ek aisi fasal se banta hai jiski kheti Patna tatha Gaya kshetra me purani thi; isliye is vyapar par niyantran ka matlab tha ki munafe ka bada hissa angrejon ke haath me chala jaye. Dutch tatha French companies ne is ekadhikar ke viruddh Patna tatha Chinsura se kai memorial yaani likhit shikayatein bhejin, jiske baad Governor Verelst ne 12 March 1767 ko Muhammad Reza Khan ko aadesh diya ki is vyapar me unhe unka uchit hissa milne se roke jane wale avrodh hata diye jayein. Exam point: 1761 me English East India Company ne Bihar me afim (opium) ke nirman tatha vyapar par ekadhikar sthapna kiya; anya European companies ko sirf seemit matra milti thi; Dutch-French ne memorial bheje tatha 12 March 1767 ko Verelst ne Muhammad Reza Khan ko avrodh hatane ka aadesh diya.

qe: In 1763 the English Company's Resident at which place complained that the Dutch gomastas were obstructing English investments by clandestine purchases from the weavers?
qh: 1763 में किस स्थान पर अंग्रेज कंपनी के रेसिडेंट ने शिकायत की कि डच गुमाश्ते बुनकरों से चोरी-छिपे खरीद कर अंग्रेजों के निवेश को रोक रहे हैं?
e: Bedara (1759) ke baad angrejon tatha Dutch ke beech rishte theek nahi the, chahe dono ke beech khuli takkar nahi hui. 1763 me English Company ke Resident at Maldah ne Calcutta Council ko shikayat bheji ki Dutch ke gomastas yaani vyaparik aadmi bade paimana par angrejon dwara lagaye gaye bunakaron se chori-chhipe khareed kar angreji investment ko rok rahe hain. Investment ka arth us daur me woh mal tha jo Europe bhejne ke liye ekatra kiya jaata tha, aur bunakar dono companies ke liye kapda banate the. Aisi shikayatein dikhati hain ki 18vein sadi me European companies aapas me sasta mal jama karne ki kadi pratiyogita karti thi, chahe rajnitik roop se unke sambandh kaise bhi rahein. Exam point: 1763 me Maldah ke Resident ne shikayat ki, Dutch gomastas bunakaron se chori-chhipe khareed kar angreji investment rok rahe hain; us daur me investment = Europe bhejne ke liye ekatra kiya gaya mal; Dutch tatha angrejon me khuli takkar nahi hui thi.

qe: News of the Patna massacre of 1763 reached Calcutta through correspondence of the Dutch at Chinsura, who had learnt of it from a letter written by which chief of the Dutch factory at Patna?
qh: 1763 के पटना नरसंहार की खबर कलकत्ता उन डचों के पत्र-व्यवहार से पहुँची जो चिनसुरा में थे, और जिन्हें यह बात पटना की डच फैक्ट्री के किस प्रमुख के पत्र से मिली?
e: Patna me 1763 me angreji kaidiyon ka narsankhar hua tha tatha uski khabar sabse pehle kshetra ke vyapariyon tatha company karmcharion ke zariye phaili. Patna ki Dutch factory ke pramukh John Bacheracht tatha unke second adhikari Andries Schultz ne Chinsura ke Dutch Council ke logon ko, jinme Louis Taillefert bhi the, khat likh kar Patna kshetra ki halat batayi; usi patra-vyavahar se Chinsura ke Dutch logon ko ghatna ka pata chala tatha aage Calcutta me angreji Council ko yah khabar pahunchi. Bacheracht Patna ki Dutch factory ke chief the, isliye yah prashn unke naam par hai. De Wilde Cassimbazar ki factory se jude the tatha 1760 me Nawab ne unhe giraftar kiya tha. Exam point: Patna ki Dutch factory ke chief John Bacheracht tatha unke second Andries Schultz ne Chinsura ke Dutch Council ko khat likh kar 1763 ki ghatna batayi; usi patra-vyavahar se Calcutta ko khabar pahunchi; De Wilde Cassimbazar factory se jude the.

qe: In 1767 the Dutch complained to Governor Verelst that their boats were often detained at the customs-houses by which class of officials?
qh: 1767 में डचों ने गवर्नर वेरेल्स्ट से शिकायत की कि उनकी नावों को सीमा-शुल्क केंद्रों पर कौन-वर्ग के कर्मचारी बार-बार रोक लेते हैं?
e: 1767 me Dutch logon ne Calcutta ke Governor Verelst se shikayat ki, unki navon ko customs-houses yaani chaukiyon par chaukidar baar-baar rok lete hain tatha unse vah rakam vasool karne lagte hain jo unke hisaab se galat hai. Chaukidar logon ka dosh poora nahi tha, kyunki unhe European companies ki navon par jane wale maal ki jaanch karne tatha us par lag (duty) lene ka adhikar tha. Governor Verelst ne Muhammad Reza Khan, jo us samay Murshidabad ke naib nazim the, se kaha ki woh Dutch ki shikayaton ka hal karein, tatha yeh bhi sochna chahiye ki jaanch ke niyam dono taraf - angrej tatha anya European companies par - ek jaisa lage. Exam point: 1767 me Dutch ne Governor Verelst se shikayat ki, unki navon ko customs-houses par chaukidar rok lete hain; chaukidars ko jaanch tatha duty lene ka adhikar tha; Verelst ne naib nazim Muhammad Reza Khan ko shikayat door karne ka mandat diya.

qe: To redress the Dutch complaints about the detention of their boats in 1767, Governor Verelst asked which naib nazim at Murshidabad to take the necessary steps?
qh: 1767 में नावों को रोके जाने की डच शिकायतों को दूर करने के लिए गवर्नर वेरेल्स्ट ने मुर्शिदाबाद के किस नायब नाज़िम से जरूरी कदम उठाने को कहा?
e: 1767 me Dutch company ke logon ne Governor Verelst se shikayat ki, chaukidar unki navon ko customs par rok kar galat vasooliyaan karte hain. Governor Verelst ne is mudde par soch-vichar kar Muhammad Reza Khan se madad maangi; woh us samay Murshidabad ke naib nazim the, isliye customs tatha chaukiyon se juda prashasan unhi ke kshetra me aata tha. Unhe nirdesh diya gaya ki European companies ki navon ke saath bheje gaye dastak yaani parwana me sabhi jaankari likhi ho tatha recognised customs-stations par navon ki jaanch bhi ho, kyunki jaanch na hone par sarkar ka lag rah jaata hai tatha vyapari bina lag diye vyapar karte rahenge. Ant me Bhutmari ke chaukidar ko vah rakam lautane tatha naukri se hataye jaane ka aadesh diya gaya, jisne Dutch navon se zyada vasooli ki thi. Exam point: 1767 me Governor Verelst ne Murshidabad ke naib nazim Muhammad Reza Khan se Dutch shikayat door karne ko kaha; us daur me European companies ki navon ke saath dastak yaani parwana rahta tha; Bhutmari ke chaukidar ko vasool ki gayi rakam lautani padi.

qe: Early in 1767 the chaukidar of which place was dismissed and ordered to refund the money he had exacted from the Dutch boats?
qh: 1767 के आरंभ में किस स्थान के चौकीदार को बर्खास्त कर उससे डच नावों से वसूल की गई रकम लौटाने का आदेश दिया गया?
e: 1767 ke shuru me Dutch logon ne shikayat ki, Bhutmari ke chaukidar ne unki navon ko bewajah rok kar aam se zyada rakam vasool kar li. Chaukidar ko hataane se pehle Governor Verelst tatha naib nazim Muhammad Reza Khan ne yah dekha ki jaanch tatha duty lene ka adhikar to chauki wale karmcharion ko tha, lekin galat vasooli kisi haal me sahi nahi thi. Ant me us chaukidar ko vasool ki gayi rakam lautane tatha naukri se hatane ka aadesh diya gaya. Jahaz tatha nadiyaan us daur me Bihar tatha Bangal ke vyapar ki reedh ki haddi thi, isliye chaukiyon par navon ko roka jaana ek bada vyaparik mudda ban jaata tha. Exam point: Bhutmari ke chaukidar ne 1767 ke shuru me Dutch navon se aam se zyada rakam vasool ki thi, isliye usse rakam lautane tatha naukri se hataye jaane ka aadesh hua; chauki par jaanch tatha duty lene ka adhikar tha.

qe: In his instructions on the search of European boats, Governor Verelst named which three chowkies where search was necessary so that the sarkar's revenue was not defrauded?
qh: यूरोपीय नावों की तलाशी के निर्देश में गवर्नर वेरेल्स्ट ने किन तीन चौकियों का नाम लिया, जहाँ तलाशी जरूरी थी ताकि सरकार का राजस्व न ठगा जाए?
e: Governor Verelst ne 1767 me customs tatha navon ki jaanch ke niyam saaf karne ke liye kaha ki European companies ki navon ke saath bheje gaye dastak yaani parwane me unke maal ki poori jaankari likhi honi chahiye. Unke nirdesh me teen chowkies - Serampur, Jalangi (Jellingy) tatha Rajmahal - ka zikr tha; unhone kaha ki agar in chaukiyon par jaanch nahi hogi, to sarkar ka rajasv (lag) loota jaaega tatha European vyapari in ke beech padne wale ilaakon me bina lag diye vyapar karte rahenge. Unhone yah bhi dekha ki jab angrej tatha anya vyapari jaanch ka virodh nahi karte, to Dutch tatha French ke liye bhi virodh ka koi aadhaar nahi hona chahiye. Exam point: Verelst ne jaanch zaroori hone ke liye Serampur, Jalangi tatha Rajmahal chaukiyon ka naam liya; nirdesh tha ki European companies ki navon ke saath dastak yaani parwane me maal ki jaankari ho; jaanch na hone par rajasv ka nuksan hone ka khatra tha.

qe: The Dutch addressed several memorials of protest against the English opium monopoly in Bihar to which Governor at Calcutta?
qh: डचों ने बिहार में अंग्रेजों के अफीम एकाधिकार के विरुद्ध कई स्मारक (memorials) कलकत्ता के किस गवर्नर को भेजे?
e: Angrej East India Company ne 1761 me Bihar me afim ke nirman tatha vyapar par ekadhikar sthapna kar liya tha, jiske baad anya European companies ko is vastu ki sirf seemit matra hi kharidne ki anumati mili. Is niyam se Dutch tatha French companies naraz hui tatha unhone apni shikayat likhit roop me Governor Verelst ke paas memory yaani memorial bheje. Verelst ne 12 March 1767 ko Muhammad Reza Khan ko aadesh diya ki is vyapar me sabhi companies ko unka uchit hissa milne se roke jane wale avrodh door kiye jayein. Aise vivaran dikhate hain ki afim ke vyapar par niyantran 18vein sadi me angrejon tatha anya European companies ke beech ek bada vivaad ka mudda tha. Exam point: Dutch tatha French companies ne afim ekadhikar ke viruddh Governor Verelst ko kai memorial bheje; 12 March 1767 ko Verelst ne Muhammad Reza Khan ko unka uchit hissa dene ke liye avrodh hatane ka aadesh diya; angrej Company ne 1761 me yah ekadhikar sthapna kiya tha.

qe: In the autumn of 1780 the United Netherlands joined the league against England, and England declared war on the Dutch on which date?
qh: 1780 की शरद ऋतु में संयुक्त नीदरलैंड्स इंग्लैंड के विरुद्ध गठबंधन में शामिल हुआ, तथा इंग्लैंड ने डचों के विरुद्ध किस तारीख़ को युद्ध की घोषणा की?
e: America ke svatantrata sangram ke dauran England ka mukabla sirf America se nahi, balki Europe ke ek bade gathbandhan se bhi tha. 1780 ki sharad ritu me United Netherlands bhi England ke virodh me bane us gathbandhan me shamil ho gaya. Iske jawab me England ne 20 December 1780 ko Dutch ke khilaf yuddh ki ghoshna kar di tatha unki bastiyon ko kabze me lene ka karye shuru kar diya. Yah ghoshna Bharat me bhi turant asar dikhane lagi, kyunki Bengal tatha Bihar me Dutch ki kai kothiyan tatha Chowkiyan maujood thin. Aage chalkar 22 June 1781, 3 July 1781 tatha 6 January 1782 ki tareekhein isi yuddh ki badi ghatnaon se judi hain. Exam point: 1780 ki sharad ritu me United Netherlands England ke virodhi gathbandhan me shamil hua tatha 20 December 1780 ko England ne Dutch ke khilaf yuddh ki ghoshna ki; is yuddh ka asar Bharat me bhi pada aur Dutch bastiyan kabze me aane lagi.

qe: Which group of Dutch settlements in southern India was seized by the English by the end of the year 1781?
qh: 1781 के अंत तक अंग्रेज़ों ने दक्षिण भारत की डच बस्तियों के किस समूह पर कब्ज़ा कर लिया था?
e: Dutch ki dakshin Bharat me teen prasiddh bastiyan thi - Sadras, Pulicat tatha Negapatam. Yah teeno samudra-tat ke aise sthal the jahan se unka vyapar tatha jahazi aana-jaana chalta tha. 1780 ke aakhir me yuddh shuru hone ke baad angrezi sena tatha jahazi bade ke saath in par hamla hua tatha 1781 ke ant tak teeno angrezi kabze me aa gayin. Ceylon ki bastiyan - Trincomali tatha Fort Ostenburg - alag hain; woh 1782 ki shuruaat me kabze me aayin. Chinsura tatha Baranagore Bengal ki Dutch bastiyan thi, tatha Goa, Cochin tatha Cannanore Portuguese bastiyan thi. Exam point: dakshin Bharat ki teen Dutch bastiyan - Sadras, Pulicat tatha Negapatam - 1781 ke ant tak angrezi kabze me aa gayin; Ceylon ki bastiyan 1782 ki shuruaat me kabze me aayin.

qe: Trincomali and Fort Ostenburg on Ceylon were captured on 6 January 1782 by the British fleet under which Admiral, together with a very large property in military stores, one lakh fifty thousand dollars in specie and two Indiamen?
qh: 6 जनवरी 1782 को सीलोन के त्रिंकोमाली तथा फ़ोर्ट ऑस्टेनबर्ग पर किस एडमिरल के नेतृत्व वाले ब्रिटिश बेड़े ने कब्ज़ा किया, जहाँ सैनिक सामान, एक लाख पचास हज़ार डॉलर की नक़दी तथा यूरोप जाने को तैयार दो इंडियामैन भी मिलीं?
e: Ceylon par Dutch ki do ahem bastiyan thi - Trincomali tatha Fort Ostenburg. 6 January 1782 ko British fleet ne Admiral Sir Edward Hughes ke netritva me in dono par kabza kar liya. Is kabze me bahut bada sainik bhandar, yaani astra-shastra tatha saman, 1,50,000 dollar ki nakadi - jise specie kaha jaata hai - tatha do Indiamen jahaz, jo Europe jaane ke liye taiyar the, angrezi haath lage. Indiaman ka matlab hai East India Company ka bada vyaparik jahaz. Kuch itihaskaron ne is kabze ko 1781 me hua likha tha, lekin sarkari records se spasht hota hai ki yah 6 January 1782 ko hua tha. Exam point: Trincomali tatha Fort Ostenburg 6 January 1782 ko Admiral Sir Edward Hughes ke netritva wale British fleet ne capture kiye; usme bada sainik bhandar, 1,50,000 dollar ki nakadi tatha do Indiamen bhi mili.

qe: What had Captain Parr, commanding the sloop Chater, already captured when he reported on 2 July 1781 to the Governor-General, after receiving orders to make reprisals on the Dutch?
qh: स्लूप चेटर के कमांडर कैप्टन पार ने 2 जुलाई 1781 को गवर्नर-जनरल को रिपोर्ट देते समय पहले ही क्या पकड़ लिया था, क्योंकि उन्हें डचों पर प्रतिकार की आज्ञा मिल चुकी थी?
e: Sir Edward Hughes ne Madras pahunchne ke baad 22 June 1781 ko Captain Parr ko nirdesh bheje. Captain Parr His Majesty ke sloop Chater ke commander the. Nirdesh ka aashay yah tha ki States General yaani Dutch sangh ke jahazon, maal tatha prajaon par poore bal se pratikar yaani reprisal ke karye ko anjaam diya jaye. Isi nirdesh ke tehat Captain Parr ne chand hi dinon me Dutch ke char pilot sloop pakad liye tatha 2 July 1781 ko Governor-General ko iski report di. Pilot sloop ek chhota jahaz hota tha, jo bade jahazon ko bandargah ke raste dikhata tatha unhe sahi jagah pahunchata tha. Exam point: Captain Parr ko 22 June 1781 ko Dutch par pratikar ka nirdesh mila; uske tehat unhone char Dutch pilot sloop pakad liye tatha 2 July 1781 ko Governor-General ko report di.

qe: On which date did the Governor-General's Council at Calcutta resolve that war between Great Britain and the States of Holland should be considered as ascertained and declared, and that not an instant should be lost in carrying its measures into execution?
qh: कलकत्ता में गवर्नर-जनरल की काउंसिल ने किस तारीख़ को तय किया कि ग्रेट ब्रिटेन तथा स्टेट्स ऑफ़ हॉलैंड के बीच युद्ध को निश्चित तथा घोषित माना जाएगा तथा उसके उपायों को लागू करने में एक क्षण भी नहीं गँवाया जाएगा?
e: Captain Parr ki report, jismein yuddh ki khabar tatha pakde gaye Dutch jahaz shamil the, 3 July 1781 ko Calcutta me Governor-General ki Council ke saamne rakhi gayi. Usi din Council ne faisla kiya ki Great Britain tatha States of Holland ke beech yuddh ko nishchit tatha ghoshit maana jayega, chahe uska ailan aam tareeke se nahi hua tha, tatha is soochna ke aadhar par sambandhi sabhi upay turant lagu kiye jayenge. Council ne yah bhi maana ki is kaam me ek kshan bhi nahi ganwaya ja sakta kyunki deri hone par Dutch apni bastiyan surakshit kar sakte the. Is faisle ke baad Bengal tatha Bihar ki Dutch bastiyon ko kabze me lene ki taiyari tez ho gayi. Exam point: 3 July 1781 ko Calcutta ki Council ne Captain Parr ki report ke aadhar par tay kiya ki Holland ke saath yuddh ghoshit maana jayega tatha uske upayon ko turant lagu kiya jayega; isse Bengal tatha Bihar ki Dutch bastiyon par karwai tez hui.

qe: In a letter of 28 April 1781 defending the proposed treaty with the Dutch, Hastings denied that the Dutch soldier was contemptible and said that some of the best soldiers ever employed in India had taken service with the English after their defeat in which campaign?
qh: 28 अप्रैल 1781 के पत्र में डचों के साथ प्रस्तावित संधि का बचाव करते हुए हेस्टिंग्स ने यह मानने से इनकार किया कि डच सैनिक तुच्छ है तथा कहा कि भारत में अब तक सेवा देने वाले कुछ सर्वोत्तम सैनिक वे थे, जो किस अभियान में पराजय के बाद अंग्रेज़ों की सेवा में आए थे?
e: Dutch ke saath prastavit sandhi ka virodh ho raha tha, isliye Hastings ne apne mitra Scott ko 28 April 1781 ke patra me uske paksh me tark likhe. Ek aitraaz yah tha ki Dutch sainik tuchh yaani kamzor hota hai, lekin Hastings ne ise galat batate hue kaha ki Bharat me ab tak sabse achhe sainik humne hi rakhe hain, jinme Dutch tatha khas taur par German the, jo Colonel Forde ke abhiyan me parajit hone ke baad angrezi seva me aa gaye the. Unhone yah bhi kaha ki Dutch afsaron ki tankhwah itni kam thi ki achhe gentleman officer unke saath nahi jude, isliye prastav me Captain se upar ke ran ke officer na lene ki shart rakhi gayi thi. Exam point: Hastings ne Colonel Forde ke abhiyan me parajit hokar angrezi seva me aane wale Dutch tatha German sainikon ko Bharat ke sabse achhe sainikon me gina tatha Dutch sainik ko tuchh batane wale aitraaz ko galat kaha.

qe: In November 1778, to which government did the Dutch propose the formation of an alliance against Hyder Ali, whose march had led to depredations on territory near Cochin?
qh: नवंबर 1778 में डचों ने किस सरकार के सामने हैदर अली के विरुद्ध गठबंधन बनाने का प्रस्ताव रखा, जिसकी चढ़ाई से कोचीन के आसपास के क्षेत्र पर हमले हुए थे?
e: Cochin me Dutch basti hai-duur tak phaili hui thi tatha uske aas-paas ke ilake par Mysoor ke shasak Hyder Ali ki chadhai se nuksan hone laga. Isi kaaran November 1778 me Dutch logon ne Madras sarkar ke saamne yah prastav rakha ki Hyder Ali ke viruddh ek sanyukt gathbandhan banaya jaye. Madras sarkar ne turant is prastav par sahmati nahi di tatha faisla kiya ki woh pehle dekhegi ki unhe zyada achhi shartein milti hain ya nahi, tabhi koi nirnay legi. Isi beech dakshin bharat ki sthiti bahut nikammi ho gayi thi, kyunki Hyder Ali ne 1780 me Carnatic ilake par hamla kar diya tatha angreji fauj ko bhaari nuksan pahunchaya. Isi kaaran aage chalkar Calcutta ki sarkar ne ek bada samjhauta pesh kiya, jisme Dutch tatha Carnatic ke Nawab dono ko shamil karne ka prastav tha. Exam point: November 1778 me Dutch logon ne Madras sarkar ke saamne Hyder Ali ke viruddh gathbandhan ka prastav rakha, kyunki Hyder ki chadhai se Cochin ke aas-paas Dutch ilake par hamle hue the; Madras sarkar ne turant sahmati nahi di tatha behtar shartein aane ka intezar karne ka faisla kiya.

qe: To negotiate the proposed treaty with the Dutch at Colombo, whom did Warren Hastings send to the Nawab of the Carnatic?
qh: कोलंबो में डचों के साथ प्रस्तावित संधि की बातचीत के लिए वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स ने कर्नाटक के नवाब के पास किसे भेजा?
e: Dakshin bharat ki badalti sthiti ko dekh kar Warren Hastings ne angrejon, Dutch tatha Carnatic ke Nawab ke beech ek samjhauta banane ka prastav rakha. Hugli ke Dutch Director Mr. J. M. Ross ne is prastav par sahmati di, isliye Hastings ne Mr. James Lucy Dighton ko Carnatic ke Nawab ke paas bheja, taaki woh Colombo me Dutch logon ke saath prastavit sandhi ki baat-cheet kar sake. Dighton ki niyukti ke bad kuch samay me unhe Bombay ke President tatha Select Committee ke paas Supreme Government ki or se Resident bana kar bhi bheja gaya, jahan se unhone rajnitik jaankari bhejne ka kaam sanbhala. Is tarah ek sena-sambandhi samjhauta banane ki koshish ne alag-alag presidency ke beech naye sampark tatha tanav dono paida kiye. Exam point: Hastings ne Carnatic ke Nawab ke paas Mr. James Lucy Dighton ko bheja, taaki Colombo me Dutch logon ke saath prastavit sandhi par baat ho sake; Hugli ke Dutch Director Mr. J. M. Ross ne is prastav par sahmati di thi; baad me Dighton Bombay ke President tatha Select Committee ke paas Resident ban kar bhi bheje gaye.

qe: Under the proposed Anglo-Dutch treaty of 1780-81, what were the Dutch required to lend to the English, and what were they to receive in return?
qh: 1780-81 की प्रस्तावित आंग्ल-डच संधि के अंतर्गत डचों को अंग्रेजों को क्या देना था तथा बदले में उन्हें क्या मिलना था?
oe: Ships and guns; in return Chinsura
A body of troops, including 1000 European infantry; in return the cession of Tinnevelly and the pearl fishery right
Saltpetre; in return the Malabar coast
oh: जहाज तथा तोपें; बदले में चिनसुरा
सैनिकों का दल, जिसमें 1000 यूरोपियन पैदल सैनिक हों; बदले में टिनेवेली प्रांत का हस्तांतरण तथा मोती-मछली का अधिकार
e: Hastings ke prastav me Dutch logon ko angrejon ki madad ke liye apni sena ka ek dal dena tha, jisme ek hazaar yuropiy paidal sipahi tatha do sau yuropiy tufangi yaani artillery ke sainik shamil the. Iske badle me Dutch logon ko yah milna tha - sainikon ki tanakhah to milti hi, saath hi Tinnevelly prant hamesha-hamesha ke liye saunp diya jaata tatha Cochin ke aas-paas naye ilake jitne ka adhikar bhi milta; iske alava Ramiseram yaani Ramesvaram se dakshin ki taraf poore samundri tat par moti nikalne ka ekadhikar bhi unhe milna tha. Itni badi sharten hone ke kaaran hi is samjhauta ko 'bahut zyada' kaha gaya. Vyavhar me yah samjhauta sirf kaagaz par hi rah gaya, kyunki pehle angrejon tatha Holland ke beech yuddh chhid gaya tatha thode hi mahinon me angrejon ne Dutch bastiyon par kabza kar liya. Exam point: prastavit sandhi me Dutch ko ek hazaar yuropiy paidal tatha do sau yuropiy tufangi sainik dene the; badle me unhe sainikon ki tanakhah, Tinnevelly prant ka sthayi hastantaran tatha Ramesvaram se dakshin ke tat par moti nikalne ka ekadhikar milna tha; yah samjhauta kabhi lagu nahi ho paaya kyunki angrejon tatha Holland ke beech yuddh chhid gaya.

qe: Who, as Commander-in-chief, wrote on 1 March 1781 that he disapproved of the proposed negotiation with the Dutch as both impolitic and unconstitutional?
qh: 1 मार्च 1781 को कमांडर-इन-चीफ के रूप में किसने लिखा कि वे डचों के साथ प्रस्तावित बातचीत को अनीति-युक्त तथा असंवैधानिक मानते हैं?
e: Prastavit sandhi par virodh sirf Madras sarkar se hi nahi hua; Commander-in-Chief Sir Eyre Coote ne bhi iske viruddh apni raay likhi. Unhe sabse badi baat yah lagi ki Dighton ki niyukti tatha is samjhauta ki poori baat-cheet unse chhupai gayi thi, isliye unhone 1 March 1781 ko Calcutta ki Council ko likha ki unhe is vishay ki jaankari tak nahi di gayi. Unhone ise apne vyakti tatha pad dono ka apman bataya tatha saaf-saaf kaha ki woh Dutch ke saath prastavit baat-cheet ko 'na rajnitik' tatha 'samvidhan ke viruddh' yaani impolitic and unconstitutional maante hain. Isi ke saath Carnatic ke Nawab ne bhi is samjhauta par sahmati nahi di; unhone 11 March 1781 ko kaha ki angrejon ke raja ne pichhle April Dutch ko neutral shakti ghoshit kiya tha, isliye unhe Carnatic me zyada prabhav badhane se roka jana chahiye. Is tarah is prastav ko Madras sarkar, Nawab tatha Commander-in-Chief, teeno ka virodh mila. Exam point: Sir Eyre Coote ne 1 March 1781 ko likha ki ve Dutch ke saath prastavit baat-cheet ko impolitic tatha unconstitutional maante hain; unhone yah bhi likha ki Dighton ki niyukti ki jaankari unse chhupai gayi, jise unhone apne pad ka apman bataya; Carnatic ke Nawab ne bhi 11 March 1781 ko is samjhauta par sahmati nahi di.

qe: Which two reasons chiefly caused the negotiations for the proposed Anglo-Dutch treaty of 1780-81 to fail?
qh: 1780-81 की प्रस्तावित आंग्ल-डच संधि की बातचीत मुख्यतः किन दो कारणों से विफल रही?
oe: The Mughal emperor refused permission, and the Dutch left India
The English had no money, and the Dutch had no troops
Opposition of the Madras government and the Nawab, and the Dutch themselves procrastinated
The French attacked Calcutta, and Hyder Ali died
oh: मुगल सम्राट ने अनुमति नहीं दी तथा डच भारत छोड़ गए
अंग्रेजों के पास धन नहीं था तथा डचों के पास सैनिक नहीं थे
मद्रास सरकार तथा नवाब का विरोध, तथा डचों द्वारा ही बातचीत को टालना
फ्रांसीसियों ने कलकत्ता पर हमला किया तथा हैदर अली की मृत्यु हो गई
e: Prastavit angrej-Dutch sandhi ki baat-cheet do mukhya kaaran se poori tarah vifal rahi. Pehla karan yah tha ki Madras sarkar ne kuch khaas kaaranon se is vyavastha ka virodh kiya tatha Carnatic ke Nawab ne bhi iski sharton par sahmati nahi di. Doosra karan yah tha ki Dutch logon ne khud hi baat-cheet ko taalta rahe, isliye samay nikalta gaya. Isi beech angrejon tatha Holland ke beech yuddh chhid gaya, jiska asar bharat me unke paraspar samparkon par bhi pada tatha thode mahinon me angrejon ne yahan ki Dutch bastiyon par kabza kar liya. Baad me Hastings ne khud likha ki unhe khushi hai ki yah prastav thukra diya gaya, kyunki jis majboori me uski shuruat hui thi, woh lambe samay tak nahi rahi. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki kaagaz par bane bade samjhauta bhi rajnitik tatha samayik haalaton ke badle turant badal jaate the. Exam point: prastavit sandhi ki baat-cheet Madras sarkar tatha Carnatic ke Nawab ke virodh ke kaaran tatha Dutch logon dwara baat-cheet taalne ke kaaran vifal rahi; isi beech angrejon tatha Holland ke beech yuddh chhid gaya tatha angrejon ne yahan ki Dutch bastiyon par kabza kar liya; Hastings ne baad me kaha ki unhe yah prastav thukraye jaane par khushi hai kyunki uski majboori samapt ho chuki thi.

qe: In 1778, which settlement was captured by Lt-Colonel Alexander Dow on the outbreak of war between England and France?
qh: 1778 में इंग्लैंड तथा फ्रांस के बीच युद्ध छिड़ने पर लेफ्टिनेंट-कर्नल अलेक्जेंडर डॉ ने किस बस्ती पर अधिकार किया?
e: March 1778 me England tatha France ke beech yuddh shuru hone par bharat me bhi haalat turant badal gayin. 9 July 1778 ko Lt-Colonel Alexander Dow ne Chandernagore ki French basti par adhikar kar liya. Isi ke aage 10 July 1778 ko Hugli ke Dutch Director tatha Council ne Calcutta ki Council ko patra likha; unhone kaha ki unhone unka patra pa liya hai tatha kyunki unhe apne upari adhikariyon se koi aadesh nahi mila, isliye ve apne sthiti par vichar karne ke liye tayaar hain. Iske alava Dutch logon ne 1778 me Cochin ke kile ko saat burjon yaani bastions tatha khaiyon se mazboot kiya, taaki unke khoe hue ilake dobara paaye ja sakein. Aise ghatnayein dikhati hain ki yuropiy Companyon ke aapas ke jhagde ka asar Bihar tatha Bangal ke vyapar tatha Dutch bastiyon par seedha padta tha. Exam point: March 1778 me England tatha France ke beech yuddh chhida tatha 9 July 1778 ko Lt-Colonel Alexander Dow ne Chandernagore par adhikar kar liya; 10 July 1778 ko Hugli ke Dutch Director tatha Council ne Calcutta ko patra likh kar apni sthiti par vichar karne ki baat kahi; 1778 me Dutch logon ne Cochin ke kile ko saat burjon tatha khaiyon se mazboot kiya.

qe: In 1772 the Dutch Director at Chinsura and the Chief of their Patna factory represented against the payment of an annual tribute of Rs 30,000. Who were these two officers?
qh: 1772 में चिनसुरा के डच डायरेक्टर तथा पटना फैक्ट्री के मुख्य अधिकारी ने 30,000 रुपये के वार्षिक नजराने के भुगतान के विरुद्ध प्रतिवेदन दिया। वे दो अधिकारी कौन थे?
oe: Mr. Sohnlein and Mr. Van Braam
Mr. Van Dankelman and Mr. Eilbracht
Mr. Vernet and Mr. De Saumaise
oh: श्री ज़ोनलाइन तथा श्री वान ब्राम
श्री वान डांकेलमान तथा श्री आइल्ब्राख्त
श्री वर्नेट तथा श्री डी सोमेज़
e: 1772 me Dutch logon ne Bihar sarkar ko diye jaane wale 30,000 rupaye ke saalana nazrane ke viruddh apna virodh darj karaya. Yah pratinidhitva karne wale do adhikari the - Chinsura ke Dutch Director Mr. Bacheracht tatha Patna ki Dutch factory ke chief Mr. Falk. Inhone tark diya ki is nazrane ka mool uddeshya puraana ho chuka hai tatha jin adhikariyon ko iska bada hissa milta tha, woh ab Dutch ki madad ya nuksan nahi kar sakte, kyunki Bangal me hue rajnitik badlavon ke baad satta angrejon ke haath me aa chuki thi. Warren Hastings ne is maang ko turant swikaar nahi kiya; unhone kaha ki aadhe shatabdi purane record ki jaanch kar ke sarkar apne hi adhikar ko galat nahi thahra sakti. Isi kaaran yah vivaad 1770 ke dashak bhar chalta raha. Exam point: 1772 me nazrane ke viruddh pratinidhitva Chinsura ke Dutch Director Mr. Bacheracht tatha Patna factory ke chief Mr. Falk ne kiya; unka tark tha ki nazrane ka puraana uddeshya pura ho chuka hai tatha faayda lene wale adhikariyon ki satta khatm ho chuki hai; Hastings ne record ki jaanch ke naam par ise turant sweekar nahi kiya.

qe: The annual tribute of Rs 30,000 paid by the Dutch at Patna originated in 1716 as a payment for protection of their trade against whose harassing activities?
qh: पटना में डचों द्वारा दिया जाने वाला 30,000 रुपये का वार्षिक नजराना 1716 में किसकी उत्पीड़नकारी गतिविधियों से व्यापार की सुरक्षा के बदले दिया जाना शुरू हुआ था?
e: Patna me Dutch logon ka 30,000 rupaye saalana nazrana koi naya kar nahi tha; uska aarambh 1716 me hua tha. Us samay Dutch vyapar ko Chakwar naam ki ek shaktishali janjati ke utpeedan se bachane ke liye ek chhota-sa bhugtan Bihar sarkar ko kiya jaata tha; us janjati ka gadh Monghyr jile ke Begusarai ilake me tha tatha woh aas-paas ke vyaparik raston par hamla karti thi. Samay ke saath suraksha band hone ke baad bhi yah bhugtan badhta chala gaya tatha 30,000 rupaye tak pahunch gaya, jisme 15,000 rupaye sarkar ke kaam ke liye, 10,500 rupaye diwan tatha anya adhikariyon ko tatha shesh bhent-baant ke samaan kharidne me laga diya jaata tha. Isi kaaran Dutch ne ise 'nazrana' ke roop me nahi, balki puraani suraksha vyavastha ka avshesh maana. Exam point: 1716 me Chakwar janjati ke utpeedan se Dutch vyapar ki suraksha ke liye chhota bhugtan shuru hua tha; samay ke saath yah 30,000 rupaye ka saalana nazrana ban gaya, jisme 15,000 rupaye sarkar, 10,500 rupaye diwan tatha anya adhikariyon ko milte the; Chakwaron ka gadh Monghyr ke Begusarai ilake me tha.

qe: To settle the dispute over the Dutch tribute, Warren Hastings was inclined to reduce it so that Rs 15,000 be paid annually to the public treasury and Rs 5,000 to whom?
qh: डच नजराने के विवाद को सुलझाने के लिए वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स इसे घटाना चाहते थे, जिससे प्रतिवर्ष 15,000 रुपये सार्वजनिक खजाने को तथा 5,000 रुपये किसको दिए जाएँ?
e: Dutch logon ne apne nazrane ke viruddh jo dalilen di, unhe Warren Hastings ne poora nahi maana; unhone tark diya ki lambe samay tak bhugtan hota raha, isliye use prachin upbhog yaani prescriptive right ka sahyog prapt hai. Phir bhi unhone samjhauta karne ke liye nazrane ko ghatane ka prastav rakha, jisme 15,000 rupaye saalana public treasury yaani sarvajanik khazane ke liye tatha 5,000 rupaye Patna ke diwan ko uske 'due' ke roop me diya jayega. Dutch ne yah prastav sweekar nahi kiya; Chinsura ke Director ne ise galat thahrate hue nazrane ko poori tarah khatm karne ki maang dohara di. Is tarah yah vivaad 1770 ke dashak me suljha nahi, tatha aage bhi Dutch apne purane adhikaron ke liye pratinidhitva karte rahe. Exam point: Hastings ne nazrane ko ghatane ka prastav rakha - 15,000 rupaye saalana sarvajanik khazane ko tatha 5,000 rupaye Patna ke diwan ko; unka aadhaar prachin upbhog (prescriptive right) ka siddhant tha; Dutch ne prastav sweekar nahi kiya tatha nazrana poori tarah khatm karne ki maang ki.

qe: In 1772 Warren Hastings issued orders granting what to the Dutch Company as part of his reforms of trade in Bengal?
qh: 1772 में वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स ने बंगाल के व्यापार में सुधार के अंतर्गत डच कंपनी को क्या देने के आदेश जारी किए?
oe: Permission to build a fort at Patna
Exemption from all duties for ten years
oh: पटना में किला बनाने की अनुमति
दस वर्ष तक सभी चुंगी से छूट
e: Bangal me apna prashasan sudharne ke kram me Warren Hastings ne Bengal ke antarik vyapar ka punargathan shuru kiya, aur isi ka hissa hote hue 1772 me unhone Dutch Company ke liye 'Freedom of Trade' yaani vyapar ki swatantrata ke aadesh jaari kiye. Us samay se pehle Dutch tatha anya yuropiy Company ke vyapariyon ko dastak tatha aise visheshadhikaron ke naam par kai chhoti-chhoti rukavaten sahni padti thin, jinse unka vyapar prabhavit hota tha. Hastings ke is kadam se Dutch ko apna purana vyapar pehle jaisa chalane ka bharosa diya gaya, tatha angreji Company ne unse kaha ki woh unki 'ancient lawfully constituted trade' ko jaari rakhne me sahayata karegi. Aise kadam dikhate hain ki naye prashasak apni satta mazboot karne ke liye purane yuropiy pratispardhiyon ko bhi seemit rahat de rahe the. Exam point: 1772 me Warren Hastings ne Dutch Company ko 'Freedom of Trade' ke aadesh diye; yah unke Bangal ke vyaparik sudhar ka hissa tha; iske badle angreji Company ne Dutch ke purane vaidh vyapar ko jaari rakhne ka bharosa diya.

qe: In December 1773 Warren Hastings passed an order by which what was entirely taken off for the Dutch?
qh: दिसंबर 1773 में वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स ने ऐसा आदेश जारी किया जिससे डचों के लिए क्या पूरी तरह हटा दिया गया?
oe: The embargo laid upon the exportation of grain
oh: अनाज के निर्यात पर लगा प्रतिबंध
e: 1772 me vyapar ki swatantrata ka aadesh dene ke baad bhi kuch vyavharik rukavaten baaki thin, jisme sabse bada masla anaaj yaani grain ke niryat par lage pratibandh ka tha. Anaj ka niryat rokne ka uddeshya shahar ke bhandaron ko bhar kar mahngai rokna tha, lekin isse Dutch jaisi vyaparik Companyon ka kaam ruk jaata tha. Isi kaaran December 1773 me Warren Hastings ne ek aadesh jaari kiya, jisse Dutch par anaaj niryat karne ka pura pratibandh hata liya gaya. Is tarah ke kadam dikhate hain ki us daur me anaaj ka niryat keval vyapar ka vishay nahi tha, balki sarkari neeti ka bhi vishay tha; saath hi yeh bhi dikhata hai ki naye shasak purane vyaparik sahyogiyon tatha pratispardhiyon ke prati narmi bhi dikha rahe the. Exam point: December 1773 me Hastings ke aadesh se Dutch par anaaj niryat karne ka pratibandh pura hataya gaya; isse pehle 1772 me unhe vyapar ki swatantrata di gayi thi; aise kadam anaaj-niti tatha vyaparik hiton ke beech santulan dikhate hain.

qe: In April 1775 two members of the Dutch Council were sent on deputation to the Council in Calcutta carrying a Memorial of their grievances. Who were they?
qh: अप्रैल 1775 में डच काउंसिल के दो सदस्य अपनी शिकायतों का स्मारक-पत्र लेकर कलकत्ता की काउंसिल में प्रतिनिधि के रूप में भेजे गए। वे कौन थे?
e: 1774 ke ant me Calcutta ki Council ne Dutch logon ko bataya ki Fort William me Regulating Act ke tahat nayi sarkar vyavastha lagu ho chuki hai, tatha unse kaha ki woh unke purane vaidh vyapar ko jaari rakhne me poori sahayata karegi. Is bharose par Dutch logon ne April 1775 me apni Council ke do sadasya - Messrs. Van Dankelman tatha Eilbracht - Calcutta me pratinidhi ke roop me bheje. Inke saath ek Memorial yaani smarak-patra bheja gaya, jisme Dutch ne pichhle atharah saalon ki apni shikayatein tatha badhaayen likhi thin; unka kehna tha ki unke purane adhikar tatha visheshadhikar samay-samay par taare hue hain, jisse unki Company ki sthiti bigadti gayi hai. Is tarah dekhne me aata hai ki British sarkar ke aashwasan tatha vyavhar me antar hone se Dutch ko baar-baar likhit shikayat karni padti thi. Exam point: April 1775 me Dutch Council ke Van Dankelman tatha Eilbracht Calcutta me pratinidhi ke roop me bheje gaye; ve apne atharah saalon ki shikayaton ka Memorial le gaye the; yah deputation 1774 ke ant me diye aashwasan ke baad bheji gayi thi.

qe: An agreement was made in 1774 for the supply of saltpetre from Patna to the Dutch, but how did the Council in Calcutta reply in November 1774 to their demand for more?
qh: 1774 में पटना से डचों को शोरा देने का समझौता हुआ, परंतु अधिक मात्रा की मांग पर कलकत्ता की काउंसिल ने नवंबर 1774 में क्या उत्तर दिया?
oe: That saltpetre would be sent only after the rains
That it was restricted from increasing the quantity by orders of its superiors
That the Dutch must pay double price
That no agreement had ever been made
oh: कि शोरा बरसात के बाद ही भेजा जाएगा
कि अपने ऊपरी अधिकारियों के आदेश से मात्रा बढ़ाने पर रोक है
कि डचों को दुगना दाम देना पड़ेगा
कि ऐसा कोई समझौता कभी हुआ ही नहीं
e: Bihar ka Patna shora yaani saltpetre ke vyapar ka bada kendra tha; shora barood banane ka mukhya kachcha maal hota hai, isliye us daur ke yuddh-vyapar me uski maang bahut zyada thi. 1774 me Patna se Dutch ko shora dene ka samjhauta hua, lekin unhe jo maal mila woh unki aavashyakta ke hisaab se bahut kam tha. Isi kaaran Hugli ki Dutch Council ne November 1774 ke shuru me Calcutta ki Council ko likh kar kaha ki pichhle kai saalon se unhe itna kam shora mila hai ki woh samjhauta hi poora nahi hota tatha usse unki Company ko bhaari nuksan ho raha hai; unki maang ki unka hissa badhaya jaye. Calcutta ne 7 November 1774 ko jawab diya ki unke upari adhikariyon ke aadesh se woh unka saalana quota badhane par rok laga chuke hain, kyunki unke apne hisse ka maal bhi unki maang poori nahi karta. Aisi patra-vyavahar dikhati hai ki Patna ke shora vyapar par poora niyantran angreji Company ke paas chala gaya tha. Exam point: 1774 me Patna se Dutch ko shora dene ka samjhauta hua, lekin maal kam mila; November 1774 me Calcutta Council ne 7 November 1774 ko dikhaya ki upari adesh se unka quota badhana sambhav nahi; shora barood ka kachcha maal hone ke kaaran yuddh ke daur me uska mahatva bahut zyada tha.

qe: On which ground did Warren Hastings justify the continuation of the Dutch tribute of Rs 30,000?
qh: वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स ने डचों के 30,000 रुपये के नजराने को जारी रखने का औचित्य किस आधार पर बताया?
oe: Long-continued possession gave the claim the sanction of prescriptive right
It was compensation for Dutch losses in the war
The Dutch had accepted it in a written treaty
The Mughal emperor had ordered its payment
oh: लंबे समय तक भुगतान चलने से दावे को प्रचलित उपभोग का अधिकार प्राप्त हो गया
यह युद्ध में डचों के नुकसान की भरपाई थी
डचों ने लिखित संधि में इसे स्वीकार किया था
मुगल सम्राट ने इसके भुगतान का आदेश दिया था
e: Dutch logon ne is nazrane ko is aadhaar par chunauti di ki uska mool uddeshya samapt ho chuka hai, isliye woh ab vaidh nahi raha. Warren Hastings ne iske uttar me tark diya ki sarkar ka kaam aadhe shatabdi purane record khangal kar apne hi adhikaron ko galat thahrna nahi hai; kisi bhi tareeke se yah adhikar pehle lagu hua ho, lambe samay tak ek paksh ka bhugtan tatha doosre paksh ki sahmati use 'prescriptive right' yaani prachin upbhog ka sahyog de deti hai, tatha yah rashtraon ke samanya vidhan ke anukool hai. Unhone yah bhi tark diya ki sarkari adhikariyon ko milne wale fees unke pad ke dues hote hain tatha woh sarkar ki hi sampatti mani jaati hai, kyunki woh unke vetan ka hissa hote hain; isi tarah lambe samay se ek hi anupat me milne wale fees ko bhi prescriptive right prapt ho jaata hai. Is tarah Hastings ne vyavharik tatha vidhik dono aadhaar gin kar nazrana banaye rakhne ka paksh rakha. Exam point: Hastings ne nazrana banaye rakhne ka aadhaar 'prescriptive right' yaani prachin upbhog ka siddhant bataya; unka tark tha ki lambe samay ka bhugtan tatha sahmati ise vaidh banati hai; unhone adhikariyon ke fees ko sarkar ki sampatti maana, isliye vah bhi prescriptive right ke daayare me aa gaya.

qe: During the 1760s which class of workmen became so scarce throughout Bengal that the gomastas of every European company tried to seduce them from the service of the others?
qh: 1760 के दशक में बंगाल भर में कौन-से कामगार इतने अभाव में हो गए कि हर यूरोपीय कंपनी के गुमाश्ते उन्हें दूसरों की सेवा से बहका लाने की कोशिश करने लगे?
e: Bedara (1759) ke aas-paas ke daur me Bangal me bunakaron yaani tantis ka aisa abhaav ho gaya ki sabhi European companies ke gomastte aapas me unhe bahkane ki koshish karne lage. Investment ka arth us daur me woh mal tha jo Europe bhejne ke liye ekatra kiya jaata tha tatha is mal ka bada hissa bunakaron dwara banaya gaya kapda tha; isliye har company chahti thi ki uske paas pehle se hi kapde ka stock rahe. Company ke gomastte bunakaron ko paisa de kar is shart par bandh lete the ki woh kisi doosri company ke liye kaam nahi karenge, jisse doosri company ko kapda milna mushkil ho jaata tha. Isi pratiyogita ne aage angrejon tatha Dutch ke beech bade vivaad paida kiye tatha isi mudde par 1767 me ek joint commission tak bana. Exam point: 1760 ke daashk me Bangal me bunakar (tanti) itne kam ho gaye ki sabhi European companies ke gumaste unhe ek-doosre se bahkane lage; investment = Europe bhejne ke liye ekatra kiya gaya mal, jiska bada hissa kapda tha; is pratiyogita ne aage vivaad paida kiye.

qe: To end the competition for workmen, what arrangement among the European companies did the Dutch propose?
qh: कामगारों के लिए होड़ खत्म करने के लिए डचों ने यूरोपीय कंपनियों के बीच कौन-सी व्यवस्था सुझाई?
oe: A ban on advances to weavers
A fixed price for all cloth
A joint monopoly of all piece-goods
A distribution of the weavers among the companies
oh: बुनकरों को पेशगी देने पर रोक
सारे कपड़े का एक तय दाम
कंपनियों के बीच बुनकरों का बंटवारा
e: Bangal me bunakaron ka abhaav badhne par sabhi European companies ke gomastte ek doosre ke bunakaron ko bahkane lagte the. Is jhagde ko khatm karne ke liye Dutch logon ne yah sujhaav rakha ki sabhi European companies ke beech bunakaron yaani tantis ka bantwara yaani distribution kar diya jaye, taaki har company ke paas apne bunakar hon tatha doosri company unhe bahka na sake. Governor ne is prastav par apni sahmati is shart ke saath di ki pehle Dutch ki aapattiyon ki jaanch ki jayegi tatha isi kaam ke liye ek joint commission niyukt kiya gaya. Commission Clive ke prashasan ke dauran is samasya ka koi hal nahi nikaal paayi, kyunki dono paksh apni-apni shart par ade rahe. Exam point: bunakaron ke liye ho rahi khinch-tan ko khatm karne ke liye Dutch ne bunakaron (tantis) ke bantware ka prastav rakha; Governor ne pehle Dutch ki aapattiyon ki jaanch ki shart par sahmati di tatha ek joint commission banaya; commission koi hal nahi nikaal paayi.

qe: The Governor assented to the Dutch proposal on the condition that the Dutch complaints should first be enquired into, and for this purpose what was appointed?
qh: गवर्नर ने डच प्रस्ताव पर इस शर्त के साथ सहमति दी कि पहले डचों की शिकायतों की जांच होगी, तथा इस उद्देश्य से क्या नियुक्त किया गया?
oe: A committee of the Nawab's officers
e: Bunakaron ke bantware ke Dutch prastav par Governor ne apni sahmati is shart ke saath di ki pehle Dutch ki shikayaton ki jaanch ki jayegi tatha isi uddeshya se ek joint Commission niyukt kiya gaya. Commission apna kaam poora nahi kar paayi, kyunki English log chahte the ki pehle unki shikayaton ki jaanch ho, jabki Dutch ka aagraha tha ki pehle bunakaron ki ginti tatha list bane. 17 March 1767 ko Verelst ne Directors ko likha ki doosri European bastiyon ke saath is mudde par koi uchit samjhauta karna zaruri hai. Aage jab commissioners ka kaam dobara shuru hone wala tha, tab bhi dono paksh apni shartein dohraate rahe. Exam point: bunakaron ke bantware ke liye ek joint Commission niyukt kiya gaya; English pehle apni shikayaton ki jaanch chahte the tatha Dutch pehle bunakaron ki list banana chahte the, isliye commission koi hal nahi nikaal paayi; Verelst ne is mudde par samjhauta zaruri bataya.

qe: Which council wrote to the English on 14 June 1767 that in Bengal the workmen were obliged, against their will, to take money and bind themselves not to work for anybody else but the English?
qh: किस काउंसिल ने 14 जून 1767 को अंग्रेजों को लिखा कि बंगाल में कामगारों को उनकी इच्छा के विरुद्ध पैसा लेकर यह बंधन मानना पड़ता है कि वे अंग्रेजों के अलावा किसी और के लिए काम नहीं करेंगे?
e: Bunakaron ke liye chal rahi khinch-tan ke dauran dono pakshon ne aapas me sakht khaton ka istemal kiya. 14 June 1767 ko Chinsura ki Dutch Council ne English logon ko likha ki Bangal me kaamgaron ko unki ichha ke viruddh paisa le kar yah bandhan maanna padta hai ki ve Angrejon ke alawa kisi aur ke liye kaam nahi karenge; Dutch ne yah bhi kaha ki gambhirata se dekhein to is baat se aap me se bahut log anjaan nahi hai. Is aarop ke jawab me English log yahi kahte rahe ki pehle Dutch ki aapattiyon ki jaanch honi chahiye tatha bunakaron ki ginti ka kaam baad me ho. Ant me Verelst ne is mudde ko Nawab tatha uske afsaron ke paas bhej diya, jinhone bantware ka virodh kiya. Exam point: 14 June 1767 ko Chinsura ki Dutch Council ne English ko likha ki Bangal me kaamganon ko unki ichha ke viruddh paisa lekar Angrejon ke alawa kisi ke liye na kaam karne ka bandhan maanna padta hai; English pehle apni shikayaton ki jaanch chahte the; aage yah mudda Nawab tatha unke afsaron ke paas bheja gaya.

qe: Verelst believed that the partition of the weavers would be a difficult and lengthy business and would bring what into contempt?
qh: वेरेल्स्ट का मानना था कि बुनकरों का बंटवारा कठिन तथा लंबा काम होगा और इससे किसकी प्रतिष्ठा घटेगी?
e: Verelst ka vichaar tha ki bunakaron ka bantwara ek kathin tatha lamba kaam hoga tatha isse Nizamat yaani Nawab ki sarkar tatha uske adhikariyon ki pratishtha ghategi. Isi kaaran unhone is mudde par apne aap faisla karne ke bajaye Nawab tatha unke afsaron se raay maangna theek samjha. Nawab ke adhikariyon ne kadi aapatti rakhi ki bantware se tantis par bada dukh aayega, kyunki unhe jo daam diya jayega wahi manna padega tatha ve sabse zyada daam dene wale ko maal nahi bech payenge; isse desh ke vyapariyon ke adhikar tatha aage unki gujara bhi prabhavit honge. Unhone yah bhi kaha ki isse maal ka utpadan itna ghat jayega ki desh ke logon ke liye bhi kaafi nahi hoga tatha sarkar ke rajasv me bhi bhaari kami aayegi. Exam point: Verelst ne kaha ki bunakaron ka bantwara kathin tatha lamba kaam hoga tatha isse Nizamat yaani Nawab ki sarkar ki pratishtha ghat jayegi; isliye unhone yah mudda Nawab tatha unke afsaron ke paas bheja; unke afsaron ne bantware ka kadi aapatti ki.

qe: The Nawab's officers objected to the distribution of weavers on the ground that the tantis would have to accept the price offered instead of selling to the highest bidder, and that it would cause a fall in what?
qh: नवाब के अफसरों ने बुनकरों के बंटवारे पर इस आधार पर आपत्ति की कि तांती को दिया गया दाम मानना पड़ेगा, वे सबसे ऊँचा दाम देने वाले को माल नहीं बेच पाएंगे, तथा इससे किसमें गिरावट आएगी?
oe: The output of the Company's factories
e: Jab bunakaron ke bantware ka mudda Verelst ne Nawab tatha unke afsaron ke paas bheja, to unhone is prastav ki kadi aapatti ki. Unke tark yah the ki aise bantware se tantis ko jo daam diya jayega wahi maanna padega tatha ve sabse zyada daam dene wale vyapari ko maal bech nahi payenge. Isse desh ke vyapariyon ke adhikar khatm ho jayenge tatha aage unki gujara ke liye zaruri cheezein mushkil se milegi. Unhone yah bhi kaha ki isse maal ka utpadan itna kam ho jayega ki woh desh ke logon ki zarurat ke liye kaafi nahi rahega tatha sabse badi baat yah hogi ki sarkar ke rajasv yaani aay me kaafi kami aa jayegi. Verelst ne in tarkon ko uchit maana tatha Dutch ki bantwara wali maang ko manzoor nahi kiya, lekin unke liye kuch nayi riyayatein zarur ki gayin. Exam point: Nawab ke afsaron ne bunakaron ke bantware ka virodh kiya kyunki isse tanti ko tay daam maanna padta, adhikar tatha gujara prabhavit hote tatha sarkar ke rajasv me bhaari kami aati; Verelst ne Dutch ki bantwara wali maang manzoor nahi ki, lekin unhe kuch nayi riyayatein di gayin.

qe: At the request of the English Governor, the Nawab's government promised to encourage the tantis by reducing the abwabs and other taxes. What was the mangan, which they also promised not to demand from the Dutch merchants?
qh: अंग्रेज गवर्नर के अनुरोध पर नवाब की सरकार ने तांती को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए अबवाब तथा अन्य कर घटाने का वचन दिया। 'मंगन' क्या था, जिसे डच व्यापारियों से न वसूलने का वचन भी दिया गया?
oe: A fee for the Nawab's permission to trade
A cess for the allowances of officers at customs-houses and landing places
oh: व्यापार की नवाब की अनुमति का शुल्क
सीमा-शुल्क केंद्रों तथा घाटों के कर्मचारियों के भत्ते के लिए लगाया गया उपकर
e: Verelst ne Dutch ki bantwara wali maang manzoor nahi ki, lekin unke liye kuch nayi riyayatein di gayin. Angrej Governor ke anurodh par Nawab ki sarkar ne do vade kiye: pehla yah ki tantis ko protsahit karne ke liye abwab tatha anya kar kam kiye jayenge, tatha doosra yah ki Dutch vyapariyon se mangan naam ka upkar nahi maanga jayega tatha bina uchit kaaran unhe pareshan nahi kiya jayega. Mangan asal me woh upkar tha jo customs-houses yaani chaukiyon tatha ghaton par tainaat karmcharion ke bhatte ke liye lagaya jaata tha; us daur me aise kai chhote-kar milte the jo vyapariyon ke liye bhaari pad jaate the. In riyayaton se Dutch ke vyapar ko kuch rahat mili tatha ummeed ki gayi ki maal ka utpadan bhi badhega. Exam point: mangan ek aise upkar tha jo chaukiyon tatha ghaton ke karmcharion ke bhatte ke liye vasoola jaata tha; Nawab ki sarkar ne abwab tatha anya kar kam karne tatha Dutch se mangan na maangne ka vada kiya; yah riyayatein Verelst ke anurodh par di gayin.

qe: In February 1768, Muhammad Reza Khan visited Hugli and argued before which Dutch Director that the village of Partabpur was within Hugli and had never been annexed to Chinsura?
qh: फरवरी 1768 में मुहम्मद रज़ा खान हुगली गए तथा किस डच डायरेक्टर के सामने यह तर्क रखा कि परताबपुर गाँव हुगली के भीतर है तथा कभी चिनसुरा में शामिल नहीं किया गया?
e: Dutch tatha Nawab ki sarkar ke sambandh bantware ke samjhote ke baad bhi sadharan nahi rahe. Dutch logon ne Hugli ke paas Partabpur gaon ko apne kshetra me mila liya tha tatha us gaon ka rahne wala Mirza Kazim, jo pehle Hugli ke faujdar ka naib raha tha, kuch niji kaaranon se is badlav par aankh band kar gaya. February 1768 me Muhammad Reza Khan Hugli gaye tatha Dutch Director Mr. G. L. Vernet ke saamne yah tark rakha ki Partabpur Hugli ke kshetra ke andar hai tatha use kabhi Chinsura me shamil nahi kiya gaya; unhone gaon ko Nawab ko lauta dene ke liye kaha. Isi tarah Dutch ke kuch anya kaam bhi Nawab ki sarkar ko napasand the, jinme Ganga par maal dho-ne-laane ke shulk ka na dena shamil tha. Exam point: February 1768 me Muhammad Reza Khan ne Dutch Director G. L. Vernet ke saamne tark rakha ki Partabpur gaon Hugli ke andar hai tatha kabhi Chinsura me shamil nahi hua; Dutch ne yah gaon apne kshetra me mila liya tha tatha Mirza Kazim ne isme madad ki thi; Ganga par shulk na dena bhi ek vivaad ka mudda tha.

qe: The faujdar of Hugli detained the Dutch piece-goods and invested Chinsura on 3 October 1768 because the Dutch Company had not paid what for several years?
qh: हुगली के फौजदार ने डचों के थान-कपड़े रोक कर 3 अक्टूबर 1768 को चिनसुरा को घेर लिया, क्योंकि डच कंपनी ने कई वर्षों से क्या नहीं चुकाया था?
oe: The mangan of the Patna chowkies
Duties for conveying goods up and down the Ganges
oh: गंगा पर ऊपर-नीचे माल ढोने के शुल्क
e: Dutch logon dwara Ganga par upar-neeche maal dho-ne-laane ke jo shulk dena tha, woh unhone kai saal tak nahi chukaya tha. Nawab ne Hugli ke faujdar ko aadesh diya ki woh apne uchit shulk sakht tarike se vasool kare. Faujdar ne ek chubdar ko Dutch Governor ke paas bheja, jo rakam maangta hua yah dhamki bhi di ki na dene par Dutch ka koi bhi maal aage nahi jaane diya jayega. Dutch Director ne is kadi sandesh se naraz hokar chubdar ko bahut bura-bhala kaha tatha apne fiskal De Saumaise ke paas bhej kar usse kadi saza dilwai. Iske jawab me faujdar ne Dutch ke saare callicoes tatha anya piece-goods rok liye, jo November 1768 me Europe jaane wale Dutch jahazon ka cargo banna tha, tatha 3 October 1768 ko usne Chinsura ko zameen ki taraf se gher liya. Ghere ke kaaran khane-peene ki itni kami ho gayi ki gaon ke kai log bhookhe mar gaye. Exam point: Hugli ke faujdar ne Dutch ke piece-goods rok kar 3 October 1768 ko Chinsura ko zameen ki taraf se gher liya kyunki Dutch ne Ganga par maal dho-ne-laane ke shulk kai saal tak nahi chukaye the; Dutch Director ne chubdar ko kadi saza dilwai thi; ghere se khane-peene ki kami ho gayi tatha kai log mar gaye.

qe: Which European traveller, visiting India in 1665-66, noted Dutch establishments at Patna and described Bengal as the common storehouse of cotton and silk for all neighbouring kingdoms and Europe?
qh: 1665-66 में भारत आने वाले किस यूरोपीय यात्री ने पटना में डच बस्तियों का उल्लेख किया तथा बंगाल को समीपवर्ती राज्यों और यूरोप के लिए कपास व रेशम का भंडार बताया?
e: Francois Bernier ek French vaidya tatha yatri the, jinhone 1665-66 me bharat ka bhraman kiya. Unke vivaran me Patna me Dutch (Holland ke) vyapariyon ki bastiyon ka zikr milta hai. Unhone Bangal ko 'common storehouse' yaani aam bhandar kaha, jahan se cotton (kapas) tatha silk (resham) bharat tatha padosi deshon ke saath-saath Europe tak jaate the. Us samay Ganga ke kinare Patna tatha Fatuha jaise sthal angrejon, French tatha Dutch vyapariyon ke factory yaani kaarkhane tatha aurang ke roop me kaam karte the, jahan mal jama kar samundri jahazon se Europe bheja jaata tha. Isi kaaran un dino Patna kshetra ka vyapar bahut phaila hua tha. Marco Polo terahvin sadi me aaya tha tatha Hiuen Tsiang cheeni Bauddh yatri tha, isliye woh is samay ke nahi hai. Exam point: Francois Bernier (1665-66) ne Patna me Dutch bastiyon ka zikr kiya tatha Bangal ko cotton-silk ka common storehouse kaha; 17vein sadi me Patna tatha Fatuha European companies ke vyaparik kendra the.

qe: By the saltpetre contract of 1744 at Patna, the chiefs of which three European trading companies agreed that only the Dutch chief would buy up all the saltpetre of that year?
qh: पटना में 1744 के शोरा (सेल्टपीटर) अनुबंध से किन तीन यूरोपीय व्यापारिक कंपनियों के प्रमुखों ने माना कि उस वर्ष का सारा शोरा केवल डच प्रमुख ही खरीदेगा?
e: Bihar us samay saltpetre (shora) ka bada utpadak kshetra tha. Saltpetre barood (gunpowder) banane ka mukhya kachcha maal hai, isliye Europe ke yuddhon ke dauran iski maang lagatar badhti rahi. Patna tatha Fatuha me angreji, French tatha Dutch companies ke factory the tatha teeno ke beech shora kharidne ki kadi pratiyogita chalti thi, kyunki kharidne wala hi munafa kamata tha. March 1744 me teeno companies ke Patna ke pramukhon ne aapas ke hit ko dekhte hue ek anubandh kiya, jisme tay hua ki us varsh ka saara shora keval Dutch pramukh hi khareedega; angrej tatha French ya unke aadmi kisi bhi jagah shora nahi khareedenge tatha Dutch pramukh baaki companies ko unka hissa nirdharit daam par dega. Isi tarah 1746 me teeno ne dobara aisa anubandh kiya, lekin kuch kaaranon se yah sahyog lambe samay tak nahi chala. Danish, Portuguese tatha Swedish companies is vyavastha ka hissa nahi thi. Exam point: 1744 tatha 1746 ke Patna saltpetre anubandh = English, French tatha Dutch companies; tay hua ki ek varsh ka saara shora keval Dutch pramukh khareedega tatha baaki companies ko hissa nirdharit daam par dega; saltpetre barood ka mukhya kachcha maal hai.

qe: In 1745, which two influential merchants of Patna offered twenty-five thousand rupees at the Nawab's court to make the European companies buy saltpetre only from them?
qh: 1745 में पटना के किन दो प्रभावशाली व्यापारियों ने नवाब के दरबार में पच्चीस हजार रुपये देकर यूरोपीय कंपनियों को शोरा केवल उन्हीं से खरीदने पर विवश करने की कोशिश की?
e: 1745 me Patna ke do prabhavshali vyapari Omichand tatha Deepchand ne Nawab ke darbar me pachchis hazaar rupaye dene ka prastav rakha, taaki European companies shora (saltpetre) keval unhi se khareedein. Isse unhe vyapar par ek tarah ka adhikar tatha munafa dono milta, kyunki beech me aane wale vyapari ki jagah woh sabhi supply apne haath me le lete. European companies ko yah vyavastha pasand nahi aayi, kyunki unke liye shora seedha kisanon tatha kaarigaron se lena sasta padta tha; isliye angrej, French tatha Dutch ne 5 January 1746 ko dobara ek doosra shora-anubandh kiya, jiska uddeshya aapas me mil kar kharid ki shartein tay karna tha. Aage 1753 me angrej company ne Omichand ke saath hi shora ki supply ka anubandh kiya, kyunki barood ki maang tatha Europe ke yuddh tez ho rahe the. Jagat Seth, Ramnarain tatha Shitab Rai anya mahatvapurn vyakti the, lekin is prastav se seedha jude nahi the. Exam point: 1745 me Omichand tatha Deepchand ne Nawab ke darbar me 25,000 rupaye dekar shora keval unse kharidne ki shart rakhne ki koshish ki; 5 January 1746 ko teen European companies ka doosra shora-anubandh hua; 1753 me angrej company ne Omichand se anubandh kiya.

qe: In 1758, control over the saltpetre farms of Bihar passed to the English East India Company after it was secured from which Nawab?
qh: 1758 में बिहार के शोरा-ठेकों (saltpetre farms) पर नियंत्रण किस नवाब से लेकर अंग्रेज ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के पास गया?
e: Plassey (1757) ke baad Bangal me angrejon ka daba badh chuka tha. 1758 me Clive ne Nawab Mir Jafar se Bihar ke saltpetre farms par poora niyantran le liya. Saltpetre farm ka arth hota hai woh vyavastha, jisme sarkar kisi vyakti ya company ko shora banane tatha bechne ka ek-adhikar yaani theka de deti hai; yah adhikar milne par company kisanon tatha kaarigaron se shora le sakti thi tatha apne hisaab se daam tay kar sakti thi. Bihar me shora ke mukhya kendra Ganga ke kinare ke kshetra the, khaas taur par Patna tatha Fatuha; yahan se shora jahazon se Europe jaata tha tatha barood banane ke kaam aata tha. Isi niyantran ke baad Dutch tatha French companies ka shora-vyapar aur kam ho gaya tatha aage ke samjhoton me yah vyapar angrejon ke paas hi rah gaya. Mir Kasim, Alivardi Khan tatha Shuja-ud-daula se yah adhikar nahi mila. Exam point: 1758 me Clive ne Mir Jafar se Bihar ke saltpetre farms ka purna niyantran liya; saltpetre farm = shora banane tatha bechne ka theka; Bihar ke kendra Patna tatha Fatuha the; Plassey (1757) ke baad angrejon ka daba badha.

qe: The battle of Bedara (25 November 1759), in which the Dutch were decisively defeated in Bengal, was won by forces under which officer?
qh: 25 नवंबर 1759 की बेदारा की लड़ाई, जिसमें बंगाल में डचों को निर्णायक पराजय मिली, किस अफसर के नेतृत्व में जीती गई?
e: 25 November 1759 ko Bedara ke maidan par, jo Chandernagore tatha Chinsura ke beech padta hai, angreji tatha Dutch senaon ke beech ladai hui. Is ladai me Colonel Forde ki aguvai me angrejon ne Dutch ko poora hara diya. Dutch sena ke sardaar Colonel Roussel the, jo ek French sipahi the tatha Dutch ki taraf se lad rahe the. Ladai bahut chhoti, khooni tatha nirnayak rahi; Dutch aadhe ghante se bhi kam samay me bhaag khade hue. Jab Forde ne Clive se aadesh maanga, to us samay Clive tash khel rahe the; unhone khat ke peeche pencil se likh kar jawab diya ki turant unse lado. Is vijay ke baad Dutch rajnitik shakti ke roop me bharat me kabhi nahi ubhre tatha unka vyapar bhi gir gaya. Major Adams ne Patna liya tha, Captain Rattray ne 1857 me madad ki thi tatha Admiral Watson samudri adhikari the. Exam point: Bedara ki ladai = 25 November 1759, Colonel Forde ne Dutch ko haraya; Dutch senapati Colonel Roussel the; Clive ka jawab tha ki turant lado; isi ke baad bharat me Dutch ki rajnitik shakti khatm ho gayi.

qe: After the battle of Bedara, the settlement of December 1759 allowed the Dutch to keep how many European soldiers for their factories at Chinsura, Cassimbazar and Patna?
