qh: बेदारा की लड़ाई के बाद दिसंबर 1759 के समझौते से डच अपने चिनसुरा, कासिमबाजार तथा पटना के कारखानों के लिए कितने यूरोपीय सैनिक रख सकते थे?
e: Bedara ki haar ke baad Dutch ki sthiti bahut kamzor ho gayi. 3 December 1759 ko unhone apne jahazon ke kaam ko galat maana tatha khud ko hamlavar maan kar kharcha tatha nuksan bharne par sahmati di. Uske do din baad, 5 December 1759 ko Miran ne Dutch ko apne kshetra me rehne tatha vyapar ki suvidha dene ki shartein rakhi: woh kabhi yuddh me bhag nahi lenge, sena ki bharti nahi karenge tatha kila ya nayi suraksha-deewar nahi banayenge; apne kaarkhane Chinsura, Kasimbazar tatha Patna ke liye keval ek sau pachchis European sipahi rakh sakte hain, isse zyada nahi. Apne jahaz tatha bachi hui sena desh se bahar bhejni hogi, warna unhe yahan se nikal diya jaaega. In shartein ne unhe poori tarah kamzor kar diya. Exam point: December 1759 ke samjhote me Dutch Chinsura, Kasimbazar tatha Patna ke kaarkhane ke liye keval 125 European sipahi rakh sakte the; unhe yuddh, sena-bharti tatha kila-nirman se roka gaya; jahaz tatha bachi sena desh se bahar bhejni thi.

qe: Under the convention of August 1760, which trade was reserved exclusively to the English, dealing a lasting blow to the Dutch in Bihar?
qh: अगस्त 1760 के समझौते (convention) के तहत कौन-सा व्यापार केवल अंग्रेजों के लिए आरक्षित कर दिया गया, जिसने बिहार में डचों को चोट पहुँचाई?
e: 23 August 1760 ke convention yaani samjhauta me tay hua ki Dutch ko apne kaarkhane ke sipahi simatne tatha extra topkhana tatha hathiyar hata dene the; unhe naye kila ya suraksha-deewarein banane ki bhi manahi thi. Isi samjhauta me Nawab ke diwan Umid Rai ne saaf kaha ki Dutch log Bangal, Bihar tatha Orissa me apna vyapar chala sakte hain, lekin saltpetre (shora) ka vyapar sirf angrejon ke paas rahega. Iska matlab yah hua ki Bihar ka sabse keemti export maal unke haath se nikal gaya tatha aage unke munafe ka bada hissa khatm ho gaya. Isi karan Dutch ka vyapar dhire-dhire khatm hota gaya. Opium, nil (indigo) tatha namak ke vyapar par is samjhauta me aisa saaf ek-adhikar angrejon ko nahi diya gaya. Exam point: August 1760 ke convention me saltpetre vyapar sirf angrejon ke liye reserve hua; Dutch ko sipahi simatne tatha hathiyar hatane ki shart mani padi; diwan Umid Rai ne yah shart rakhi; isse Bihar me Dutch ka munafa ghat gaya.

qe: In which years did the Dutch finally give up their settlements in Bengal and Bihar to the British Government?
qh: डच लोगों ने बंगाल तथा बिहार की अपनी बस्तियाँ अंततः ब्रिटिश सरकार को किन वर्षों में सौंप दीं?
e: Bedara (1759) tatha 1760 ke samjhoton ke baad Dutch ki rajnitik shakti toot gayi thi, lekin unke kaarkhane tatha vyapar kuch samay tak chalta raha. 19vein sadi ke shuru me Europe ke yuddhon ke kaaran Dutch ki sthiti aur kamzor padi tatha aakhir me 1824-25 me ek samjhote ke tahat unhone apni Bengal tatha Bihar ki bastiyan, jaise Chinsura, British Government ko saunp din. Iske saath hi bharat me Dutch East India Company ke sabse purane vyaparik adhyay ka ant ho gaya. Aage Dutch ka poora dhyan Indonesia ke kshetra par lag gaya, jahan unka bada samrajya tha, isliye bharat me unki ruchi khatm ho gayi. 1795-96, 1760-61 tatha 1857-58 anya ghatnaon ke varsh hain tatha is ghatna se mel nahi khate. Exam point: Dutch ne apni Bengal tatha Bihar ki bastiyan (Chinsura aadi) 1824-25 me British Government ko saunpi; Bedara (1759) tatha 1760 ke convention ke baad unki shakti gir chuki thi; aage Dutch ka dhyan Indonesia par lag gaya.

qe: In 1789 the Dutch set up a sugar factory at Motipur, a place that today lies in which district of Bihar?
qh: 1789 में डचों ने मोतिपुर में चीनी की फैक्ट्री स्थापित की थी; मोतिपुर आज बिहार के किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: 1789 me Dutch logon ne Motipur me cheeni (sugar) ki factory sthapit ki; yah sthal aaj Muzaffarpur jile me hai. Yah baat dikhati hai ki Dutch ka vyapar sirf Patna tatha Fatuha ke shora tak seemit nahi tha, balki uttar Bihar ke krishi-kshetron me bhi unke kaarkhane kaam karte the, jahan ganne tatha anya krishi-utpadon se cheeni tatha sharbat banane ka kaam hota tha. Us daur me Bihar me ganne ki kheti tatha cheeni banane ki parampara phail chuki thi, isliye aise factory ke liye uttar Bihar ka kshetra upyukt tha; aaj bhi Muzaffarpur apni litchi tatha krishi-vyapar ke liye jaana jaata hai. Motihari, Darbhanga tatha Bhagalpur anya kshetra hain, jahan yah vishesh factory nahi lagi. Exam point: Motipur me Dutch cheeni factory = 1789; Motipur aaj Muzaffarpur jile me hai; isse pata chalta hai ki Dutch vyapar Patna-Fatuha ke shora ke alava uttar Bihar ke krishi-kshetron tak phaila hua tha.

qe: In July 1781, when the seizure of the Dutch settlement of Chinsura was decided upon, which officer, then commanding at Chandernagore, was directed to proceed immediately with the force under his command to Chinsurah?
qh: जुलाई 1781 में जब चिनसुरा की डच बस्ती पर कब्ज़ा करने का निर्णय हुआ, तब चंद्रनगर में तैनात किस अधिकारी को आदेश दिया गया कि वह अपनी कमान के बल के साथ तुरंत चिनसुरा पहुँचे?
e: Jab angrezi Company ne Holland ke khilaf yuddh ke samay Dutch bastiyon par kabza karne ka nirnay liya, tab Calcutta ki Council ne Chandernagore me tainat Captain Charles Chatfield ko kaha ki woh apni command ke force ke saath turant Chinsurah pahunche. Unhe nirdesh mila ki nagar ke sabhi raste zameen tatha paani dono taraf se rok len, kisi bhi nivasi ko wahan se jaane na den tatha koi paisa, sikka ya saamaan bahar nahi jaane den. Iske baad unhe ek toli ke saath kila ja kar Governor Mr Ross se kila, nagar tatha nivasiyon ka turant samarpan maangna tha; kila ki chaabi milne par niyukt commissaries ko us par adhikar dena tha. Isi tarah har fauji chhavni ke adhikariyon ko apne kshetra ki Dutch factories par turant kabza lene ke nirdesh bheje gaye. Exam point: July 1781 me Chandernagore me tainat Captain Charles Chatfield ko Chinsurah pahunch kar nagar ke raste rokne tatha kila, nagar aur nivasiyon ka samarpan maangne ka nirdesh mila; kila ki chaabi milte hi commissaries ko us par adhikar dena tha.

qe: When the English force reached Chinsurah, from which Governor was the immediate surrender of the fort, together with the town and the inhabitants, to be demanded?
qh: जब अंग्रेज़ी सेना चिनसुरा पहुँची, तब किस गवर्नर से किला, नगर तथा निवासियों का तुरंत समर्पण माँगा जाना था?
e: Chinsurah ke kila me pahunch kar angrezi toli ko Governor Mr Ross se kila, nagar tatha nivasiyon ka turant samarpan maangna tha. Nirdeshon me kaha gaya tha ki agar Governor samarpan dene se inkar karta hai to us par yuddh me bahne wale sabhi rakta ka uttaradayitv maan liya jaayega tatha force ke saath kila, nagar tatha sarkari-private dono prakar ki sampatti par kabza karne ka har prayas kiya jaayega. Board ye nahi maanta tha ki Chinsura ka Governor inkar karega, kyunki uske paas prabhavi virodh karne layak koi force nahi thi. Nirdeshon me yah bhi kaha gaya ki nivasiyon ke saath poora narmta ka vyavhar kiya jaye tatha nirdesh palan ke liye zaroori se zyada koi hinsa na ki jaye. Exam point: Chinsurah me Governor Mr Ross se kila, nagar tatha nivasiyon ka turant samarpan maanga jaana tha; inkar par rakta-paat ka uttaradayitv unhi par daala gaya tatha nivasiyon ke saath narmta ka vyavhar ka nirdesh diya gaya.

qe: What did the Council in Calcutta order the commissaries appointed for Chinsura to do in the first instance?
qh: कलकत्ता की काउंसिल ने चिनसुरा के लिए नियुक्त कमिश्नरों को सबसे पहले क्या करने का आदेश दिया?
oe: To take a particular account of the money and bullion in the Dutch Company's treasury
To dismiss all the Dutch servants from service
To buy the Dutch warehouses for the English Company
To send the Dutch Governor as prisoner to Calcutta
oh: डच कंपनी के खजाने में रखे धन तथा सोने-चाँदी का विस्तृत हिसाब लेना
डच कर्मचारियों को नौकरी से हटा देना
डच गोदामों को अंग्रेज़ी कंपनी के लिए खरीद लेना
डच गवर्नर को कैदी बना कर कलकत्ता भेजना
e: Chinsurah ke liye niyukt commissaries ko Council se nirdesh mila ki sabse pehle woh Dutch Company ke khazane me rakhe paise tatha sikka (bullion) ka vistrit hisab len, tatha uske baad alag-alag warehouses yaani godamon me ja kar har ek me rakhe saamaan ki suchi (inventory) banayen. Unhe Governor Mr Ross se Dutch Company ke paise, sikka tatha maal ka poora hisab maangna tha tatha unke apne-apne vibhagon ke karmachariyon ki sahayta leni thi. Unhe yah bhi maangna tha ki Dutch Company ne apne investment yaani kharid ke liye jitna advance diya, usi ka hisab diya jaye - kaun sa maal mil gaya tatha kaun sa abhi dena hai. Sampatti ke hisab rakhne ke liye chaabi tatha taale commissaries ke paas hi rakhe jaate the. Exam point: commissaries ka pehla kaam Dutch Company ke khazane ke paise tatha bullion ka vistrit hisab lena tha, uske baad godamon ka saamaan ganana, Governor Ross se poora hisab maangna tatha investment ke advance ka vivaran lena tha.

qe: Besides Charles Purling, S. Heatly and Robert Adair, which fourth person was appointed a commissary on the part of the English Company's government to take charge of the fort and town of Chinsura?
qh: चार्ल्स पर्लिंग, एस. हीटली तथा रॉबर्ट अडेयर के अतिरिक्त किस चौथे व्यक्ति को अंग्रेज़ी कंपनी की सरकार की ओर से चिनसुरा के किले तथा नगर का प्रभार लेने के लिए कमिश्नर नियुक्त किया गया?
e: Chinsurah ke kila tatha nagar ka prabhar lene ke liye angrezi Company ki sarkar ki or se char commissaries niyukt kiye gaye - Charles Purling, S Heatly, Robert Adair tatha Henry Ramus. Yeh chaaron Company ke government ke niyukt adhikari the, jinka kaam kabze ke baad Dutch sampatti ki ganana, abhilekh sambhalna tatha investment ka kaam sambhalna tha. Inhe Council se order mila ki woh Governor Mr Ross se Dutch Company ke paise, bullion tatha maal ka hisab len tatha unke karmachariyon ki sahayta len; bad me inke adhin Dutch aurungs yaani kapda-bunai ke karya-sthal rakhe gaye. Captain Charles Chatfield fauj ke adhikari the, isliye woh commissary nahi the, balki commissaries ke saath milkar kaam karne wale sainik pramukh the. Exam point: Chinsurah ke liye niyukt char commissaries the - Charles Purling, S Heatly, Robert Adair tatha Henry Ramus; Captain Chatfield fauj ke adhikari the tatha commissaries ke saath milkar kaam karte the.

qe: Under the orders issued during the seizure of Chinsura, what distinction was made among the European inhabitants of the place?
qh: चिनसुरा पर कब्ज़े के समय दिए गए आदेशों में वहाँ के यूरोपियन निवासियों के बीच क्या अंतर रखा गया था?
oe: All of them were thrown into prison and tried
All of them were sent away to Europe
All of them were allowed to move about freely on their own word
Those of a superior order were allowed the parole, and the rest were kept in close custody
oh: उन सबको जेल में डाल कर मुकदमा चलाया गया
उन सबको यूरोप भेज दिया गया
उन सबको अपने वचन पर खुली आवाजाही की छूट दी गई
उच्च श्रेणी के लोगों को पैरोल दी गई, तथा शेष को कड़ी हिरासत में रखा गया
e: Chinsurah ke nirdeshon me yuropiy nivasiyon ke liye shreni ke aadhar par vyavhar alag-alag rakha gaya. Jinke European nivasi uchch shreni yaani senior order ke the, unhe parole di gayi - parole ka arth hai bandi nahi banaya jana, balki apna vachan de kar chhut ke saath rahna. Baaki sabhi nivasiyon ko kadi hirasat yaani close custody me rakha gaya. Yahi nirdesh patra (circular letter) me bhi dohraya gaya, jo Committee of Revenue, Patna, Murshidabad tatha Dacca ki angrezi factories ke mukhiyaon tatha Balasore ke Resident ko bheja gaya; unse kaha gaya ki apne-adhikar kshetra me sthit Dutch factory ke paise, sikka tatha sampatti ki suchi banayen tatha uski suraksha karen. Exam point: Chinsurah me uchch shreni ke yuropiy nivasiyon ko parole di gayi tatha shesh ko kadi hirasat me rakha gaya; yahi nirdesh Patna, Murshidabad, Dacca ki factories tatha Balasore ke Resident ko bhi bheja gaya.

qe: The circular letter ordering inventories of the effects in the Dutch factories was sent to the Committee of Revenue, the chiefs of the English factories of Patna, Murshidabad and Dacca, and the Resident at which place?
qh: डच कारखानों की संपत्ति की सूची बनाने का परिपत्र कमेटी ऑफ़ रेवेन्यू, पटना, मुर्शिदाबाद तथा ढाका की अंग्रेज़ी फैक्ट्रियों के प्रमुखों तथा किस स्थान के रेसिडेंट को भेजा गया?
e: Chinsurah par kabze ke samay Council ne ek paripatra (circular letter) jaari kiya, jo Committee of Revenue, Patna ki angrezi factory ke mukhiya, Murshidabad ki factory ke mukhiya, Dacca ki factory ke mukhiya tatha Balasore ke Resident ko bheja gaya. Is paripatra ka ashay tha ki ve apne-adhikar kshetra me sthit Dutch factory me jo paisa, sikka tatha sampatti mile, uski suchi banayen, uski theek tarah suraksha karen tatha uski jaankari Chinsurah ke commissaries ko bhejein. Unhe yah bhi kaha gaya ki woh commissaries ke nirdeshon ke mutabik aage ka kaam karen tatha superior order ke European nivasiyon ko parole den, baaki ko kadi hirasat me rakhen. Exam point: Dutch factories ki sampatti ki suchi banane ka paripatra Committee of Revenue, Patna, Murshidabad tatha Dacca ki factories ke mukhiyaon tatha Balasore ke Resident ko bheja gaya; Inke baad sabhi nirdesh Chinsurah ke commissaries se hi diye jaate the.

qe: Under the rules framed for the commissaries at Chinsura, what was to be done with the Treasury, Magazine, Warehouses and Storehouses of every denomination?
qh: चिनसुरा के कमिश्नरों के लिए बनाए गए नियमों के अनुसार हर प्रकार के खजाने, मैगज़ीन, गोदाम तथा भंडार-गृहों के साथ क्या किया जाना था?
oe: They were to be sold by public auction
They were to be emptied at once and destroyed
They were to be handed over to the Dutch Governor
They were to be taken charge of and sealed up by the commissaries
oh: उन्हें सार्वजनिक नीलामी से बेच दिया जाएगा
उन्हें तुरंत खाली करा कर नष्ट कर दिया जाएगा
उन्हें डच गवर्नर को सौंप दिया जाएगा
उनका प्रभार लेकर कमिश्नर उन्हें सील कर देंगे
e: Chinsurah ke commissaries ke liye Council ne kaam ki ek suchi yaani line of duty tay ki. Uska pehla niyam yah tha ki har prakar ki Treasury yaani khazana, Magazine, Warehouses tatha Storehouses ka prabhar commissaries len tatha unhe seal yaani seal band kar den. Doosre niyam me kaha gaya ki Dutch Company ki sabhi bahiyan, pustakein tatha kagazat commissaries ko saunpe jayein, saath hi khazane ka balance tatha saamaan ka extract hisab bhi diya jaye; commissaries us hisab ki tulna anya bahiyon se karenge tatha Governor se pooch kar batayenge ki paisa tatha maal kahan rakha hai. Iske baad inki jaanch kar hisab se milane par unhe apne taale tatha chaabi ke neeche rakha jayega. Exam point: pehle niyam ke mutabik khazana, magazine, godam tatha bhandar-grih ka prabhar lekar unhe seal kiya jana tha; doosre niyam me Dutch Company ki bahiyan, pustakein tatha kagazat tatha balance ka extract hisab saunpna zaroori tha.

qe: When the accounts and papers of the Dutch Company were delivered up to the commissaries, what was to be given along with them for comparison?
qh: जब डच कंपनी के हिसाब तथा कागज़ात कमिश्नरों को सौंपे गए, तब तुलना के लिए उनके साथ क्या दिया जाना था?
oe: An extract account of the balance in cash and of all goods and stores
A list of the Dutch soldiers and guns
A map of the province of Bengal
The title-deeds of the town of Chinsura
oh: नकद शेष तथा समस्त माल और भंडार का संक्षिप्त हिसाब
डच सैनिकों तथा तोपों की सूची
e: Commissaries ke kaam ke doosre niyam me yah vyavastha thi ki Dutch Company ki sabhi bahiyan, pustakein tatha kagazat unhe diye jayein tatha uske saath nakit cash ka balance tatha sabhi goods tatha stores ka extract yaani sankshipt hisab bhi diya jaye. Commissaries is extract hisab ki tulna un anya bahiyon se karte the jo Government of Chinsura ki or se unhe saunpi gayi thi. Tulna me hisab sahi milne par Governor tatha Council se yah poochha jaata tha ki paisa kahan rakha hai tatha maal aur stores kahan hain; unki jaanch karne par bhi hisab mil jaane par woh commissaries ke apne taale tatha chaabi ke neeche rakh diye jaate the. Aisi jaanch-padtaal ka uddeshya yah tha ki sarkari sampatti ka hisab poora aur alag-alag rakha jaye. Exam point: bahiyan tatha kagazat saunpte samay nakit balance tatha sabhi goods aur stores ka extract hisab diya jaana tha, jiski tulna anya bahiyon se hoti thi tatha hisab milne par sampatti commissaries ke taale-chaabi ke neeche rakhi jaati thi.

qe: Individual residents of Chinsura had to file, on oath and within a fixed time, an exact account of their property; under what condition alone was private property to be secured to them?
qh: चिनसुरा के व्यक्तिगत निवासियों को शपथ लेकर निर्धारित समय के भीतर अपनी संपत्ति का सही हिसाब देना पड़ता था; किस शर्त पर ही उन्हें निजी संपत्ति सुरक्षित रूप से लौटाई जानी थी?
oe: That they take service under the English Company
That they pay one-fourth of their property as tax
That they leave Bengal within one year
That a faithful account be given of all that belonged to the Dutch Company
oh: वे अंग्रेज़ी कंपनी की सेवा में आ जाएँ
अपनी संपत्ति का चौथा हिस्सा कर के रूप में दें
वे एक वर्ष के भीतर बंगाल छोड़ दें
डच कंपनी की समस्त संपत्ति का विश्वसनीय हिसाब दिया जाए
e: Nirdeshon ke teesre tatha chauthe niyam ke mutabik Chinsurah ke har vyakti ko shapath lekar nirdharit samay ke andar apni sampatti ka sahi hisab dena padta tha - paisa, maal, stores, godam ya ghar ke roop me jo kuch uske paas tha. Har vyakti ko yah batana padta tha ki uski sampatti kahan rakhi hai; uski jaanch me hisab se mel milne par sampatti us adhikari ko lauta di jaati thi. Chauthe niyam me saaf kaha gaya ki niji sampatti logon ko is spasht shart par surakshit ki jaayegi ki woh Dutch Company ki sabhi sampatti ka vishvasniya hisab denge, chahe woh Chinsurah me ho ya sarkari kshetra ke kisi anya bhaag me ho, tatha aurungon me diye gaye advance ya balance ka bhi sahi hisab denge. Exam point: niji sampatti is shart par surakshit ki jaati thi ki vyakti Dutch Company ki sabhi sampatti tatha aurungon ke advance-balance ka vishvasniya hisab de; shapath-patra ke bina koi niji sampatti nahi lauti jaati thi.

qe: The Dutch aurungs, whose advances the commissaries were to continue, were placed under whose immediate charge, and with what intention regarding the investment?
qh: जिन डच औरंगों के अग्रिम धन का काम कमिश्नरों को आगे बढ़ाना था, वे किसके सीधे प्रभार में रखे गए तथा निवेश के बारे में क्या इरादा था?
oe: Of the Dutch Governor, so that trade might continue as before
Of the Nawab's officers, so that duties might be collected
Of the commissaries, it being intended to send the Dutch investment home separately
Of the Court of Directors, for sale in London
oh: डच गवर्नर के, जिससे व्यापार पहले जैसा चलता रहे
नवाब के अधिकारियों के, जिससे चुंगी वसूल हो सके
कमिश्नरों के, तथा डच निवेश को अलग रख कर स्वदेश भेजने का इरादा था
कोर्ट ऑफ़ डायरेक्टर्स के, लंदन में बिक्री के लिए
e: Instructions ke chhathe niyam me kaha gaya ki commissaries Governor tatha Council of Chinsurah ki saunpi gayi bahiyon tatha hisabon se chalu varsh ke investment ke liye diye gaye advance ka sahi tatha alag hisab banayen. Yah bhi tay hua ki jitna investment karne ka irada tha, uski poori rashi bhi nikaal len; uske baad woh usi tarah advance dete rahenge jise Chinsurah ke Governor tatha Council apne rahte karte the. Is kaam ke liye Dutch aurungs yaani kapde ki bunai ke karya-sthal seedhe commissaries ke prabhar me rakhe gaye, jo apne mann se karmachari niyukt kar sakte the ya niyam bana sakte the. Iska maksad yah tha ki Dutch investment Company ke baaki sab kaamon se alag aur svatantra rahe, kyunki Governor-General tatha Council ka irada us Dutch investment ko alag hi swadesh bhejne ka tha. Exam point: Dutch aurungs commissaries ke seedhe prabhar me rakhe gaye tatha unhe apne mann se karmachari tatha niyam chunne ki chhoot thi; iska uddeshya Dutch investment ko baaki kaamon se alag rakh kar usi ko alag swadesh bhejna tha.

qe: Under the seventh rule for the commissaries, after reserving enough money out of the cash found at Chinsura to complete the Dutch investment, what was to be done with the overplus?
qh: चिनसुरा के कमिश्नरों के सातवें नियम के अनुसार डच निवेश पूरा करने लायक धन अलग रखने के बाद बची अतिरिक्त राशि का क्या किया जाना था?
oe: It was to be divided among the inhabitants
It was to be remitted to the Presidency
It was to be spent on repairing the fort
It was to be returned to the Dutch Company
oh: उसे निवासियों में बाँट दिया जाएगा
उसे प्रेसीडेंसी को भेज दिया जाएगा
उसे किले की मरम्मत पर खर्च किया जाएगा
उसे डच कंपनी को लौटा दिया जाएगा
e: Saatve niyam me kaha gaya ki commissaries Chinsurah ke Governor tatha Council dwara banayi gayi yojna ke mutabik chalu Dutch investment ke liye zaroori rashi ka anuman lagayen. Chunki yah kharcha Chinsurah me mile paise se hi kiya jana tha, isliye woh us investment ko poora karne layak paisa bacha kar rakhenge tatha bachi hui overplus yaani atirikt rashi Presidency yaani Calcutta ko bhej denge. Iske aathve niyam me kaha gaya ki upar bataye kaamon ke liye kaun se agents tatha karmachari zaroori honge, yah Commissioner Board ko batayen. In niyamon ka asar yah tha ki Dutch ka vyapar-bandh Company ke sarkari kaam se alag chalega tatha uske paise ka hisab bilkul alag rakha jayega. Exam point: investment ke liye zaroori rashi bachane ke baad bachi hui atirikt rashi Presidency ko bheji jaani thi; aathve niyam me agents tatha karmachariyon ki zaroorat Board ko batane ka nirdesh tha.

qe: Along with the orders to Captain Chatfield, what instructions were sent to the commanding officers at the different stations of the Army?
qh: कैप्टन चैटफ़ील्ड को दिए आदेशों के साथ-साथ सेना के विभिन्न स्टेशनों के कमांडिंग अधिकारियों को क्या निर्देश भेजे गए?
oe: To arrest all the Dutch inhabitants of their stations
To guard the Dutch factories against every kind of attack
To take immediate possession of the Dutch factories within their respective jurisdictions
To withdraw their forces to Calcutta at once
oh: अपने स्टेशनों के सभी डच निवासियों को गिरफ़्तार कर लेना
डच फैक्ट्रियों की हर प्रकार के आक्रमण से रक्षा करना
अपने-अपने क्षेत्राधिकार की डच फैक्ट्रियों पर तुरंत कब्ज़ा कर लेना
अपनी सेनाओं को तुरंत कलकत्ता लौटा लेना
e: Chinsurah ke liye bheje gaye nirdeshon ke saath hi Army ke vividh stations ke commanding officers ko bhi isi prakar ke nirdesh bheje gaye - woh apne-apne kshetra-adhikar ke andar aane wali Dutch factories par turant kabza kar len. Isi silsile me Chinsurah ke kila tatha nagar ka prabhar lene ke liye char commissaries - Charles Purling, S Heatly, Robert Adair tatha Henry Ramus - niyukt kiye gaye, tatha Committee of Revenue, Patna, Murshidabad, Dacca ki factories ke mukhiyaon tatha Balasore ke Resident ko paripatra bheja gaya. In sabhi nirdeshon ka uddeshya yah tha ki Dutch bastiyon ki sampatti par ek saath aur bina samay gawaye kabza ho jaye, taaki unka vyapar, khazana tatha karmachari angrezi satta ke niyantran me aa jayein. Exam point: Army ke alag-alag stations ke commanding officers ko nirdesh the ki woh apne kshetra-adhikar ki Dutch factories par turant kabza kar len; saath hi Chinsurah ke liye char commissaries niyukt kiye gaye.

qe: Under the tenth rule framed for the commissaries at Chinsura, what was allowed to each of them for the execution of the trust?
qh: चिनसुरा के कमिश्नरों के लिए बनाए गए दसवें नियम के अनुसार इस काम को पूरा करने के लिए प्रत्येक को क्या दिया जाना था?
oe: A salary of 500 sicca rupees per month and a commission on the net value of the money and effects secured
A fixed grant of one lakh rupees paid at the end of the trust
A salary of 100 rupees per month without any commission
A share in the Dutch Company's investment for that year
oh: प्रति माह 500 सिक्का रुपये वेतन तथा सुरक्षित किए गए धन और सम्पत्ति के शुद्ध मूल्य पर कमीशन
काम पूरा होने पर एक लाख रुपये का निश्चित अनुदान
प्रति माह 100 रुपये वेतन, कोई कमीशन नहीं
उस वर्ष के डच कंपनी के निवेश में हिस्सा
e: Chinsurah ke commissaries ke kaam ke liye banaye gaye niyamon me yah tay hua ki unhe protsahit karne tatha unke kaam ka uchit puraskar dene ke liye pratyek ko 500 sicca rupees prati mah vetan diya jaayega tatha iske atirikt un sabhi paise tatha sampatti ke shuddh mulya par jise woh surakshit karke hisab me layenge, ek commission bhi diya jaayega. Commission ka aadhar tay karne ke liye un stores ya anya cheezon ka mulyankan kiya jaana tha jo bechi nahi jayengi ya Company ke upyog ke liye rakhi jayengi. Niyam me yah bhi kaha gaya ki mulyankan ki vidhi Board aage tay karega. Is tarah ke protsahan se commissaries ka svarth sampatti ko theek se surakshit karne tatha hisab me lane se juda ho gaya. Exam point: dasven niyam ke mutabik pratyek commissary ko 500 sicca rupees prati mah vetan tatha surakshit sampatti ke shuddh mulya par commission mila; na bechi jaane wali cheezon ka mulyankan Board ki vidhi se hota tha.

qe: Under the ninth rule, the commissaries could act jointly and separately, but how were questions on which their opinions were equally divided to be settled?
qh: नवें नियम के अनुसार कमिश्नर मिल कर तथा अलग-अलग दोनों तरह काम कर सकते थे, लेकिन जिन प्रश्नों पर उनकी राय बराबर बँट जाती थी, उनका निर्णय कैसे होता था?
oe: They were decided by Captain Chatfield
They were referred for determination to the Board
They were decided by the Governor of Chinsura
oh: ऐसे प्रश्न छोड़ दिए जाते थे
उनका निर्णय कैप्टन चैटफ़ील्ड करता था
उन्हें निर्णय के लिए बोर्ड के पास भेज दिया जाता था
उनका निर्णय चिनसुरा का गवर्नर करता था
e: Chinsurah ke commissaries ke liye banaye gaye nauven niyam me kaha gaya ki ve sabhi kaam mil kar tatha alag-alag, dono tarah karne ke liye adhikari honge. Jo nirnay ve apne beech ya unme se bahumt se tay karenge, wahi manya hoga. Lekin yadi kisi prashn par unki raay barabar bat jaye, to us prashn ko nirnay ke liye Board ke paas bheja jaayega. Unhe yah bhi adhikar tha ki sampatti dhoondhne tatha surakshit karne ke behtar upayon ke liye apne kisi sadasya ko kisi bhi sthan par bhej sakein. Is tarah ke niyam se collectiv dayitv tatha samay par nirnay lene ki zarurat dono ko saath rakha gaya. Exam point: nauven niyam ke mutabik commissaries mil kar tatha alag-alag kaam kar sakte the tatha bahumt se nirnay karte the; barabar batne wale prashn Board ke paas bheje jaate the tatha ve apne sadasya ko kisi bhi sthan par bhej sakte the.

qe: In their letter of 4 July 1781 to Mr Ross, what did the commissaries ask for in the first place?
qh: 4 जुलाई 1781 को मिस्टर रॉस को लिखे अपने पत्र में कमिश्नरों ने सबसे पहले क्या माँगा?
oe: A list of the Dutch soldiers present in the fort
The keys of the town gates of Chinsura
An inventory of the money, bullion and goods of the Dutch Company supported by their accounts made up to that day
A plan of the fortifications of the fort
oh: किले में उपस्थित डच सैनिकों की सूची
उस दिन तक के हिसाब से युक्त डच कंपनी के धन, सोने-चाँदी तथा माल की सूची
e: Captain Chatfield dwara Dutch Fort at Chinsura ki chaabi commissaries ko saunp di gayi thi; iske baad ve Dutch Governor Mr Ross ke paas gaye tatha uski mang par unhe instructions tatha parole ka farm bheja. 4 July 1781 ko unhone Mr Ross ko patra likh kar sabse pehle yah maanga ki jitni jaldi sahaj ho, Dutch Company ke paise, sikka yaani bullion tatha maal ki suchi bheji jaye, tatha uske saath aaj tak ke banaye gaye hisab bhi diye jayein. Doosri mang yah thi ki Dutch ne apne investment ke liye jo advance diya, uska vivran diya jaye - kaun sa maal received hua tatha kaun sa abhi deliver karna hai. Is tarah ke hisab se sampatti ka poora lekhajokha tay kiya jaana tha. Exam point: 4 July 1781 ke patra me commissaries ne sabse pehle Dutch Company ke paise, bullion tatha maal ki suchi tatha aaj tak ke hisab maange; doosri mang investment ke advance ka vivran thi.

qe: The third item asked for in the letter of 4 July 1781 was a list of the European and other inhabitants of Chinsura, natives of Bengal, specifying what about them?
qh: 4 जुलाई 1781 के पत्र में माँगी गई तीसरी वस्तु चिनसुरा के यूरोपियन तथा बंगाल के अन्य निवासियों की सूची थी, जिसमें उनके बारे में क्या बताना था?
oe: The number of servants kept by each household
The amount of tax paid by each of them
Those considered of the rank of the Gentry, and the occupations and qualities of the rest
Their caste and their place of birth
oh: प्रत्येक घर में रखे नौकरों की संख्या
जो उच्च वर्ग की श्रेणी के माने जाते हैं, तथा शेष के व्यवसाय और योग्यताएँ
e: Chinsurah par kabze ke baad commissaries ne Mr Ross se yah bhi maanga ki woh European tatha anya nivasiyon ki, jo Bengal ke mool nivasi hain, ek vishesh suchi den; is suchi me yah spasht karna tha ki kaun log Gentry yaani uchch shreni ki ginti me aate hain tatha shesh logon ke vyavasay tatha yogytayein kya hain. Aisi suchi ka uddeshya yah tha ki parole yaani apne vachan par chhod diye jaane layak logon tatha kadi hirasat me rakhne layak logon me bhed kiya ja sake. Chauthi mang Company ke mukhya desi karmachariyon ki suchi thi, jinke Chinsurah se bahar jaane ki anumati nahi thi. Exam point: teesri mang European tatha Bengal ke anya nivasiyon ki suchi thi, jisme uchch shreni ke log tatha shesh logon ke vyavasay-yogyta bataye jaane the; isse parole dene ya kadi hirasat rakhne ka nirnay hota tha.

qe: Which list did the commissaries demand in their letter of 4 July 1781, saying that those persons could not be permitted to depart out of Chinsura?
qh: 4 जुलाई 1781 के पत्र में कमिश्नरों ने किसकी सूची माँगी और कहा कि उन व्यक्तियों को चिनसुरा से बाहर जाने की अनुमति नहीं दी जा सकती?
oe: The principal native servants of the Dutch Company
The missionaries of the Dutch factory
The European soldiers of the garrison
oh: डच कंपनी के प्रमुख देशी कर्मचारी
e: Chinsurah ke commissaries ne Mr Ross se chauthi mang me Dutch Company ke mukhya desi karmachariyon ki suchi maangi tatha likha ki unke instructions ke mutabik in karmachariyon ko Chinsurah se bahar jaane ki anumati nahi di ja sakti. Isse loug tatha sampatti ki jaankari bina ruke rahe tatha hisab ka kaam poora ho sake. Apne patra me commissaries ne yah bhi likha ki Captain Chatfield ko nirdesh hai ki woh niji tatha sarkari dono prakar ki sampatti ko surakshit kare. Mr Ross ne uttar me kaha ki woh batayi gayi sabhi baaton ka vivran dene ko taiyar hai, sirf itna anurodh hai ki niji sampatti wala point zyada udaar bhav se liya jaye. Exam point: commissaries ne Dutch Company ke mukhya desi karmachariyon ki suchi maangi tatha likha ki unhe Chinsurah se bahar jaane ki anumati nahi di ja sakti; unke patra me Captain Chatfield ko niji aur sarkari dono sampatti surakshit karne ka nirdesh tha.

qe: In his reply to the commissaries, Mr Ross requested that the article concerning private property be taken in a more favourable sense and that the Dutch Company's servants be allowed what till matters were settled in Europe?
qh: कमिश्नरों को अपने उत्तर में मिस्टर रॉस ने अनुरोध किया कि निजी संपत्ति वाली शर्त को अधिक उदार भाव से लिया जाए तथा यूरोप में बात तय होने तक डच कंपनी के कर्मचारियों को क्या दिया जाए?
oe: Permission to sell their goods at Calcutta
A salary according to their stations
Exemption from all accounts and records
oh: कलकत्ता में अपना माल बेचने की अनुमति
e: Mr Ross ne atma-samarpan ke baad kaha ki woh commissaries dwara maangi gayi sabhi baaton par vivran dene ko taiyar hai. Usne sirf itna anurodh kiya ki niji sampatti wali shart ko zyada udaar bhav se liya jaye tatha jaisa Company ke karmachariyon ko, waise hi anya European nivasiyon, anya nivasiyon tatha desi logon ko bhi unki apni sampatti surakshit rakhne ki suvidha di jaye. Usne yah bhi kaha ki Company ke sabhi karmachariyon ko unke padon ke mutabik vetan milta rahe, jab tak Europe me dono deshon ke beech mamla tay nahi ho jaata. Isse pata chalta hai ki kabze ke samay bhi admik vyavastha tatha karmachariyon ke vetan ko chalute rehne dena zaroori maana gaya. Exam point: Mr Ross ne niji sampatti wali shart udaar bhav se lene ka anurodh kiya tatha kaha ki Company ke karmachariyon ko unke padon ke mutabik vetan milta rahe, jab tak Europe me dono deshon ka mamla tay nahi ho jaata.

qe: On 5 July 1781 the commissaries went into the Council Room at Mr Ross's request to hear the Parole read; in which languages did the Dutch Council and senior merchants agree to execute it?
qh: 5 जुलाई 1781 को कमिश्नर मिस्टर रॉस के अनुरोध पर काउंसिल रूम में गए ताकि पैरोल सुन सकें; डच काउंसिल तथा वरिष्ठ व्यापारियों ने उसे किन भाषाओं में लिखे जाने पर लागू करने का सहमति दी?
e: 5 July 1781 ko commissaries Mr Ross ke anurodh par uske Council Room me gaye, jahan Dutch Company ki Council tatha senior merchants ke saamne parole yaani apne vachan par chhod diye jaane ka farm padha gaya. Wahaan upasthit sabhi logon ne yah sweekar kiya ki jaise hi vah farm Dutch tatha English dono bhashaon me likh diya jayega, woh use lagu kar denge. Mr Ross ne vada kiya ki wahaan upasthit gentlemen ka parole woh commissaries ko de dega tatha un anya Dutch karmachariyon tatha vyapar me lage logon ki suchi bhi dega, jin par unke parole ke liye bharosa kiya ja sakta tha. Is tarah bhasha me vivad na ho, isliye do bhashaon me farm likhne ki vyavastha ki gayi. Exam point: 5 July 1781 ko parole Dutch tatha English dono bhashaon me likhe jaane par lagu karne ki sahmati hui; Mr Ross ne upasthit gentlemen ka parole tatha anya vishvasniya karmachariyon ki suchi dene ka vada kiya.

qe: Which second of the Dutch factory at Cassimbazar, called to Chinsura, was permitted to return to his station after signing his parole?
qh: कसीमबाज़ार की डच फैक्ट्री का कौन-सा दूसरा अधिकारी, जिसे चिनसुरा बुलाया गया था, अपनी पैरोल पर हस्ताक्षर करने के बाद अपने स्टेशन लौटने की अनुमति पा सका?
e: Chinsurah par kabze ke baad wahan ke prabandh me kai vyavasthayein ki gayin. Dutch factory at Cassimbazar ka doosra adhikari Leonard Verspyck, jise Chinsurah bula liya gaya tha, apna parole yaani apne vachan par chhode jaane ka patra sign karne ke baad apne station par lautne ki anumati pa gaya. Do anya karmachariyon ka zikr bhi milta hai - Sibram Neogy, jo Chinsurah tatha Baranagore me Dutch ka patwari tha tatha jisse pichhle varsh se Jama Wasil ka hisab maanga gaya, usne jald dene ka vada kiya. Gopinath Roy, jo Chinsurah me Dutch ka diwan tha, usne Dutch East India Company ke godamon tatha warehouses ki suchi saunpi. Exam point: Cassimbazar factory ka doosra adhikari Leonard Verspyck parole par hastakshar karne ke baad apne station laut gaya; Sibram Neogy patwari tatha Gopinath Roy diwan ke roop me Dutch ke hisab-kitab tatha godamon se jude the.

qe: Which diwan of the Dutch at Chinsura delivered to the commissaries a list of the Dutch East India Company's godowns and warehouses?
qh: चिनसुरा में डच का दीवान कौन था, जिसने कमिश्नरों को डच ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के गोदामों तथा भंडार-गृहों की सूची सौंपी?
e: Chinsurah me Dutch ke diwan Gopinath Roy ne commissaries ko Dutch East India Company ke godamon tatha warehouses ki suchi saunpi. 8 July ko commissaries ne yah suchi Captain Charles Chatfield ko bheji tatha likha ki jin godamon me maal rakha hai, unke darwazon par guards yaani pahredar khade karne zaroori hain. Isi tarah 6 July ko commissaries ne Nanda Kumar Chakravarty, Kali Charan Bose, Ganga Narain tatha Govind Roy ko godamon tatha warehouses ka sircar niyukt kiya. Naye niyukt sircaron ko godam khol kar hawa lene dene ki anumati chahi gayi, taaki maal kharab na ho. Exam point: Dutch ke diwan Gopinath Roy ne godamon tatha warehouses ki suchi saunpi, jise 8 July ko Captain Chatfield bheja gaya; 6 July ko char sircar - Nanda Kumar Chakravarty, Kali Charan Bose, Ganga Narain tatha Govind Roy niyukt kiye gaye.

qe: As some Indian inhabitants of Chinsura were deserting their habitations after the surrender, the commissaries issued a notice on 6 July 1781; where were the three copies stuck up in the town of Chinsura?
qh: समर्पण के बाद चिनसुरा के कुछ भारतीय निवासी अपने घर छोड़कर जाने लगे थे, इसलिए कमिश्नरों ने 6 जुलाई 1781 को एक सूचना जारी की; चिनसुरा नगर में उसकी तीन प्रतियाँ कहाँ चिपकाई गईं?
oe: At the three village gates of the town
At the church, the jail and the custom house
At the Governor's house, the treasury and the mint
At the gate of the fort, at the Mirepore bazar and at the Shestamund bazar
oh: गवर्नर के घर, ख़ज़ाने तथा टकसाल पर
किले के द्वार, मीरपुर बाज़ार तथा शेस्तामुंद बाज़ार पर
e: Chinsurah ke samarpan ke baad kuch Bhartiya nivasi apne ghar chhod kar jane lage the; isse paida hone wali ghabrahat tatha asuvidha door karne ke liye commissaries ne 6 July 1781 ko ek suchna jaari ki. Us suchna ki ek copy Baranagore bheji gayi tatha teen copies Chinsurah nagar me chipkayi gayin - ek kila ke darwaze par, ek Mirepore bazar me tatha ek Shestamund bazar me. Suchna me kaha gaya ki yah gaon pehle Dutch Company ka tha tatha ab English Company ka hai; isliye sabhi log apne gharon me shaant rah kar pehle ki tarah apna vyapar karen tatha kisi ko koi hani nahi pahunchai jayegi. Exam point: 6 July 1781 ki suchna ki teen pratiyan Chinsurah me kila ke darwaze, Mirepore bazar tatha Shestamund bazar par chipkayi gayin tatha ek prati Baranagore bheji gayi.

qe: What did the notice of 6 July 1781 tell the soudagars, merchants, beparries, shroffs and ryots of Chinsura about the village and their business?
qh: 6 जुलाई 1781 की सूचना ने चिनसुरा के सौदागरों, व्यापारियों, बेपारियों, शराफ़ों तथा रैयतों को गाँव और उनके व्यापार के बारे में क्या बताया?
oe: That their lands had been resumed by the Government
That they must sell their goods only to the Dutch Company
That they should leave the village within three days
That the village now belonged to the English Company, so they should remain quiet at their houses and do their business as before
oh: उनकी ज़मीनें सरकार ने ज़ब्त कर ली हैं
वे अपना माल केवल डच कंपनी को बेचें
वे तीन दिन में गाँव छोड़ दें
गाँव अब अंग्रेज़ी कंपनी का हो गया है, इसलिए वे अपने घरों में शांत रहें और पहले की तरह व्यापार करें
e: 6 July 1781 ki suchna me kaha gaya ki Chinsurah nagar, jo Purgunnah Arsaf me Chuckla Hougli ke andar aata tha, pehle Dutch Company ka tha tatha ab English Company ka ho gaya hai. Isliye saare saudagar, vyapari, beparri, sarraf tatha raiyat se kaha gaya ki woh apne gharon me shaant rah kar pehle ki tarah apna kaam-kaaj karen tatha unme se kisi ko bhi koi hani nahi pahunchai jayegi. Jo log bhaag gaye the, unse kaha gaya ki woh apne gharon ko laut aayein; jo is aadesh ka palan nahi karenge, unhe doshi maana jayega tatha sarkar ka krodh bhugatna padega. Exam point: suchna me bataya gaya ki gaon ab English Company ka hai tatha sabhi log apne gharon me shaant rah kar pehle ki tarah vyapar karen; bhaag gaye logon ko laut aane ko kaha gaya tatha aadesh na maanne par doshi maane jaane ki chetavni di gayi.

qe: For what purpose did the commissaries ask Captain Chatfield to order the Treasury at Chinsura to be opened, no money being removable without a particular notice signed by them?
qh: कमिश्नरों ने कैप्टन चैटफ़ील्ड से चिनसुरा का ख़ज़ाना खुलवाने के लिए किस उद्देश्य से कहा, जबकि उनके हस्ताक्षरित विशेष सूचना के बिना कोई धन नहीं निकाला जा सकता था?
oe: For sending money to the Presidency at Calcutta
For paying the Dutch garrison its arrears
For the purpose of taking out the Bengal accounts
For buying provisions for the sepoys on duty
oh: कलकत्ता की प्रेसीडेंसी को धन भेजने के लिए
डच गैरिसन के बकाया वेतन देने के लिए
बंगाल के हिसाब-किताब निकालने के उद्देश्य से
ड्यूटी पर लगे सिपाहियों के लिए रसद खरीदने के लिए
e: 6 July 1781 ko commissaries ne Captain Chatfield ko patra likha ki naye niyukt sircaron ko godamon me jaane dene ki anumati di jaye, taaki woh unhe khol kar hawa lene dene ka kaam kar sakein; unhe yah bhi kaha gaya ki sipahiyon ko sakht aadesh diya jaye ki woh godamon se koi bhi chhoti se chhoti cheez bahar nahi jaane denge. Isi patra me commissaries ne anurodh kiya ki khazana is uddeshya se khola jaye ki Bengal ke hisab-kitab nikale ja sakein, lekin is baat par sakht nirnay tha ki unke hastakshar wali vishesh suchna ke bina khazane se koi paisa nahi nikala jayega. Is tarah sampatti par poora niyantran rakhne ki vyavastha ki gayi. Exam point: khazana Bengal ke hisab-kitab nikalne ke liye khola jaana tha, lekin commissaries ke hastakshar wali vishesh suchna ke bina koi paisa nikalna manaa tha; godamon se koi cheez bahar na jaane dene ke bhi sakht aadesh diye gaye.

qe: In his letter of 6 July 1781 Captain Chatfield protested that he would not be answerable for goods or treasure in the godowns unless what was done before they were opened?
qh: 6 जुलाई 1781 के अपने पत्र में कैप्टन चैटफ़ील्ड ने यह आपत्ति उठाई कि गोदामों में रखे माल या ख़ज़ाने के लिए वह उत्तरदायी नहीं होगा, जब तक गोदाम खोलने से पहले क्या न किया जाए?
oe: That all the sepoys be withdrawn from the godowns
That the godowns be handed over to the Dutch Governor again
That a particular account of what was in each godown be given to him beforehand
That the commissaries deposit a security of one lakh rupees
oh: गोदामों से सभी सिपाही हटा लिए जाएँ
गोदाम फिर से डच गवर्नर को सौंप दिए जाएँ
प्रत्येक गोदाम में क्या रखा है इसका विशेष हिसाब पहले उसे दे दिया जाए
कमिश्नर एक लाख रुपये की ज़मानत जमा करें
e: Chinsurah me godamon ka prabhar Commissaries ke paas tha tatha unke sipahi godamon ke darwazon par khade the. Captain Chatfield ne 6 July 1781 ko Commissaries ko patra likh kar spasht aapatti ki, woh Dutch Company ke godamon ya niji vyapariyon ke godamon me rakhe maal ya khazane ke liye uttardayi nahi hoga, jab tak ki godam kholne se pehle unhe yah nahi bata diya jaye ki kis godam me kya rakha hai. Usne iske liye har godam ka vishesh hisab pehle maang liya, taaki baad me kisi kami ya chori ka dosh us par na daala jaye. Isi din apne doosre patra me usne Commissaries ke patra kee shaili par bhi aapatti uthayi. Exam point: Captain Chatfield ne likha ki godamon me rakhe maal tatha khazane ke liye woh uttardayi nahi hoga, jab tak har godam me kya rakha hai iska vishesh hisab use pehle na de diya jaye.

qe: In his second letter of the same date, on what ground did Captain Chatfield object to the commissaries' letter and ask them to alter it?
qh: उसी तारीख़ के अपने दूसरे पत्र में कैप्टन चैटफ़ील्ड ने किस आधार पर कमिश्नरों के पत्र पर आपत्ति की तथा उसे बदलने को कहा?
oe: That it was couched in the style of orders which they had no authority to give him
That it was written only in the Bengali language
That it was sent without any signatures
That it demanded a large sum from the treasury
oh: वह आदेशों की शैली में लिखा गया था, जिसे देने का उन्हें कोई अधिकार नहीं था
वह केवल बंगाली भाषा में लिखा गया था
वह बिना किसी हस्ताक्षर के भेजा गया था
उसमें ख़ज़ाने से बड़ी राशि माँगी गई थी
e: Captain Chatfield ne 6 July 1781 ke apne doosre patra me likha ki Commissaries ka patra aadeshon ki shaili me likha gaya hai, jise dene ka unhe koi adhikar nahi tha, isliye woh us patra ko badal den; usne yah bhi likha ki service ke bhale ke liye jo bhi anurodh woh karenge, use pura karne ke liye woh taiyar hai. Is par Commissaries ne jawab diya ki is baat ka nirnay Board karega ki Chatfield par kitna uttaradayitv hai, tatha unke sabhi sarkari warehouses ke darwazon par Chatfield ke sipahi khade hain. Unhone apne patra ki shaili me koi galti maanne se inkar kiya tatha likha ki unka anurodh service ke hit ke virudh nahi ho sakta. Exam point: Chatfield ne aapatti uthayi ki patra aadeshon ki shaili me tha, jiska adhikar Commissaries ko nahi tha; usne service ke hit me kiye jane wale sabhi anurodh manne ki taiyari jatayi.

qe: The commissaries referred their correspondence with Captain Chatfield to the Governor-General and Supreme Council, requesting them to draw a line for his conduct so as to place them beyond the possibility of what?
qh: कमिश्नरों ने कैप्टन चैटफ़ील्ड से हुए पत्र-व्यवहार को गवर्नर-जनरल तथा सुप्रीम काउंसिल के पास भेजा और अनुरोध किया कि उसके आचरण की एक सीमा तय की जाए, जिससे वे किस स्थिति से बच सकें?
oh: मानसून के जहाज़ी सफ़र में देरी
e: Commissaries tatha Captain Chatfield ke beech patra-vyavahar me tanav badh gaya, kyunki Chatfield ne Commissaries ke patra kee shaili tatha uttaradayitv ke baare me aapattiyan uthayi. Isliye Commissaries ne apna poora patra-vyavahar Governor-General tatha Supreme Council, Calcutta ko bhej kar anurodh kiya ki Chinsurah me tainat afsar ke aacharan ke liye ek spasht seema tay ki jaye, jisse aage chalkar kaha-suni tatha vyarth aapattiyon ki sthiti na bane tatha unhe samay par zaroori anurodh karne me koi katthinai na ho. Is tarah unke kehne ke mutabik sabhi vivad upar ke adhikariyon ke nirnay ke liye bheje jaate the, tatha jis vishay par spasht nirdesh nahi the, use bhi wahi bhej diya jaata tha. Exam point: Commissaries ne apne patra-vyavahar ko Governor-General tatha Supreme Council ko bhej kar afsar ke aacharan ki seema tay karne ka anurodh kiya, taaki kaha-suni tatha vyarth aapattiyon ki sthiti se bacha ja sake.

qe: At their meeting of 9 July 1781, why did the commissaries think it advisable to defer the examination of public property?
qh: 9 जुलाई 1781 की अपनी बैठक में कमिश्नरों ने सार्वजनिक संपत्ति की जाँच को टालना उचित क्यों समझा?
oe: They were waiting for orders from the Court of Directors
The sepoys had refused to open the godowns
They had not yet received the accounts of the Dutch from Mr John Mathias Ross
The godowns had been sealed by the Dutch Governor
oh: वे कोर्ट ऑफ़ डायरेक्टर्स के आदेश की प्रतीक्षा कर रहे थे
सिपाहियों ने गोदाम खोलने से इनकार कर दिया था
उन्हें मिस्टर जॉन मथियास रॉस से डच का हिसाब अभी नहीं मिला था
डच गवर्नर ने गोदाम सील कर दिए थे
e: 9 July 1781 ko hui Commissaries ki baithak me yah faisla hua ki sarkari sampatti ki jaanch abhi tak di jaye, kyunki unhe Dutch ka hisab-kitab Mr John Mathias Ross se abhi tak nahi mila tha; isliye jaanch ko thodi der ke liye tala gaya. Usi baithak me yah bhi tay hua ki Mr Ross ko Governor-General tatha Council ke nirdesh ka extract bheja jaye, jisme sarkari sampatti ka prabhar lene ki baat thi. Saath hi unse anurodh kiya gaya ki woh Dutch Council ke sabhi sadasyaon tatha Dutch par nirbhar anya logon ko suchit karen ki unhe apni-apni sampatti ka hisab us tarikh se ek mahine ke andar dena hoga, jisme nakit rashi, maal ki matra tatha rakhne ke sthan spasht karne the. Exam point: 9 July 1781 ki baithak me sarkari sampatti ki jaanch isliye tali gayi ki Mr John Mathias Ross se Dutch ka hisab-kitab abhi nahi mila tha; saath hi ek mahine ke andar sampatti ka hisab dene ka nirdesh bheja gaya.

qe: How much time did the commissaries allow to the members of the Dutch Council and others dependent on the Dutch to render the accounts of their respective property?
qh: कमिश्नरों ने डच काउंसिल के सदस्यों तथा डच पर निर्भर अन्य लोगों को अपनी-अपनी संपत्ति का हिसाब देने के लिए कितना समय दिया?
oe: One year from the date of the treaty
oh: संधि की तारीख़ से एक वर्ष
e: 9 July 1781 ko Commissaries ne Mr Ross ko patra likh kar anurodh kiya ki woh Dutch Council ke sabhi sadasyaon tatha Dutch par nirbhar anya logon ko batayen ki unhe apni-apni sampatti ka hisab us tarikh se ek mahine ke andar dena hoga. Is hisab me yah spasht karna tha ki nakit rashi kitni hai, unka maal kitna hai tatha woh kahan rakha hua hai. Isi tarah niji sampatti ke liye bhi tay kiya gaya ki uske niyam Chinsurah ke nivasiyon ko bata diye jayein, taaki har vyakti bina der kiye tay farm me apni sampatti ka hisab taiyar kar sake. Is pranali ka uddeshya yah tha ki niyam sabhi ko ek saman roop se malum ho tatha hisab ke kaam me koi bahana na bache. Exam point: Commissaries ne ek mahine ke andar apni sampatti ka hisab dene ka nirdesh diya, jisme nakit rashi, maal ki matra tatha rakhne ka sthan batana zaroori tha; niji sampatti ke niyam sabhi nivasiyon ko bata diye gaye.

qe: What notice did the commissaries issue in the town of Chinsura for the convenience of the inhabitants, so that each of them might prepare the account of his property without delay?
qh: कमिश्नरों ने चिनसुरा नगर के निवासियों की सुविधा के लिए क्या सूचना जारी की, जिससे प्रत्येक व्यक्ति बिना देर किए अपनी संपत्ति का हिसाब तैयार कर सके?
oe: A notice requiring them to pay a fresh house tax
A notice asking the inhabitants to deliver in just accounts of their property within one month
A notice asking them to deposit all their money in the treasury
A notice ordering them to leave the town within a week
oh: नया घर-कर देने की माँग की सूचना
निवासियों से एक महीने के भीतर अपनी संपत्ति का सही हिसाब देने की सूचना
उनसे अपना सारा धन ख़ज़ाने में जमा करने की सूचना
उन्हें एक सप्ताह में नगर छोड़ने का आदेश
e: Niji sampatti ke baare me Commissaries ne yah tay kiya ki uske niyam Chinsurah ke sabhi nivasiyon ko bata diye jayein, taaki koi bhi vyakti yah na keh sake ki use niyam malum nahi the. Isi kram me unhone nagar me ek suchna jaari ki, jisme sabhi nivasiyon se kaha gaya ki woh apni sampatti ka sahi hisab ek mahine ke andar English Government ke pratinidhi Commissaries ke paas jama karen. Is hisab me unhe yah batana tha ki unke paas kitni nakit, kitna maal tatha kaun-kaun si cheezein hain tatha woh kahan rakhi hain. Iske pehle Commissaries ne 13 July 1781 ko Mr Ross ko bhi likha tha ki vyaktiyon ki niji sampatti tabhi surakshit rahegi, jab woh Dutch Company ke kaamon ka vishvasniya hisab denge. Exam point: Commissaries ne nagar me suchna jaari ki, jisme sabhi nivasi ek mahine ke andar apni sampatti ka sahi hisab den; niji sampatti ki suraksha ka aadhar Dutch Company ke kaamon ka vishvasniya hisab dena hi tha.

qe: In his reply of 11 July 1781, what did Mr Ross explain was the real intention of the order to inventory all private property?
qh: 11 जुलाई 1781 के अपने उत्तर में मिस्टर रॉस ने बताया कि सारी निजी संपत्ति की सूची बनाने के आदेश का वास्तविक इरादा क्या था?
oe: To confiscate the property of the European residents
To expel the Dutch inhabitants from Bengal
Only to prevent any concealment of the Company's goods
To raise a new tax for the English Company
oh: यूरोपियन निवासियों की संपत्ति ज़ब्त करना
डच निवासियों को बंगाल से निकालना
कंपनी के माल को छिपाने से रोकना ही
अंग्रेज़ी कंपनी के लिए नया कर वसूलना
e: 11 July 1781 ko Mr John Mathias Ross ne Commissaries ko uttar bheja. Usne likha ki unke patra ke niyamon se jo kathinaiyan tatha unhe lagu karne ke tarike me mat-bhed paida honge, us par woh apni kuch tipaniyan bhej raha hai. Usne spasht kiya ki sarkar ka yah aadesh ki sabhi niji sampatti ki suchi banayi jaye, asal me sirf isliye diya gaya hai ki Company ka maal kisi bhi tarah chhupaya na ja sake. Usne bataya ki jis hisab ki jarurat thi, woh abhi taiyar nahi ho paya kyunki kuch zaroori kagazat aise sthan par rakhe the jahan se nikalna aasan nahi tha; tatha Bengali karmachari apne kagazat ke aadhar par balance ka poora hisab nahi de sakte the. Usne jald hi Company ke har maal ka sahi hisab dene ka vada kiya. Exam point: Mr Ross ne bataya ki niji sampatti ki suchi banane ka asli uddeshya keval Company ke maal ko chhipaye jaane se rokna tha; hisab me deri ka karan zaroori kagazat tatha Bengali karmachariyon ke adhoora vivran the.

qe: As provided by article 6 of the Regulations drawn up by the Governor-General and Council, which deputy was appointed to take charge of the Dutch factory at Patna?
qh: गवर्नर-जनरल तथा काउंसिल द्वारा बनाए गए विनियमों के अनुच्छेद 6 के अनुसार पटना की डच फैक्ट्री का प्रभार लेने के लिए किस डेप्युटी की नियुक्ति की गई?
e: Governor-General tatha Council dwara banaye gaye niyamon ke article 6 ke mutabik Chinsurah ke Commissaries ne apne Deputies niyukt kiye, jo Dutch factories ka prabhar lene ke liye bheje gaye - Mr Patrick Heatly ko Patna ki factory, Mr John Craigie ko Cassimbazar ki factory tatha Mr Samuel Hasleby ko Dacca ki factory ka prabhar mila. Yah vyavastha isliye ki gayi thi ki Chinsurah ke alawa Bengal ke anya sthanon me sthit Dutch factories ki sampatti bhi turant surakshit ki ja sake tatha unka hisab alag-alag rakha jaye. Isi silsile me Patna ke Revenue Chief Mr William Maxwell, Murshidabad ke Mr William Hosia tatha Dacca ke Mr William Holland se anurodh kiya gaya ki woh apne-apne sthan par in Deputies ko har sambhav sahayta dein. Exam point: article 6 ke mutabik Mr Patrick Heatly ko Patna ki Dutch factory, Mr John Craigie ko Cassimbazar tatha Mr Samuel Hasleby ko Dacca ki factory ka prabhar mila tatha Revenue Chiefs se unhe sahayta dene ka anurodh kiya gaya.

qe: Which Revenue Chief at Patna was requested by the English commissaries at Chinsura to render all possible assistance to their deputy in the discharge of his duties?
qh: चिनसुरा के अंग्रेज़ी कमिश्नरों ने पटना के किस रेवेन्यू चीफ से अनुरोध किया कि वह अपने कर्तव्य-पालन में उनके डेप्युटी को हर संभव सहायता दे?
e: Chinsurah ke Commissaries ne apne Deputies ko Dutch factories ka prabhar saunpne ke baad tino sthanon ke Revenue Chiefs se anurodh kiya ki ve in Deputies ko unke kartvya-palan me har sambhav sahayta den. Is kram me Patna ke Revenue Chief Mr William Maxwell, Murshidabad ke Mr William Hosia tatha Dacca ke Mr William Holland ko patra bheja gaya. Aisi sahayta ki zarurat isliye thi ki Dutch factory ki sampatti, godam, bahiyan tatha karmachariyon ka prabhar bahut bada kaam tha tatha sthal ke sarkari adhikariyon ke sahyog ke bina sampatti surakshit karna kathin tha. Patna ki factory Bihar ke liye vishesh mahatv ki thi, kyunki yahan se saltpetre tatha kapde ka vyapar hota tha. Exam point: Patna ke Revenue Chief Mr William Maxwell se anurodh kiya gaya ki woh Dutch factory ke prabhar ke liye bheje gaye Deputy ko har sambhav sahayta den; Murshidabad tatha Dacca ke Revenue Chiefs ko bhi aisa hi anurodh bheja gaya.

qe: In July 1781, instructions regarding the affair of the Dutch were sent to Messrs. Edward Stephenson, Simeon Droze and Henry Cottrell, who were commercial chiefs at which three stations respectively?
qh: जुलाई 1781 में डच मामले के संबंध में एडवर्ड स्टीफेंसन, साइमन ड्रोज़ तथा हेनरी कॉटरेल को निर्देश भेजे गए, जो क्रमशः किन तीन स्थानों के वाणिज्य प्रमुख थे?
e: July 1781 me Chinsura par adhikar ke baad angrezi prabandhan ne poore Bangal tatha Bihar me Dutch vyapar sambhalne ke liye ek vyavastha banayi. Is silsile me Edward Stephenson, Simeon Droze tatha Henry Cottrell ko nirdesh bheje gaye, jo kramashah Patna, Cassimbazar tatha Dacca ke Commercial Chiefs yaani vanijya pramukh the. Inhi stationon par Dutch Company ke factory tatha godown the, isliye unhe apne-apne kshetra me Dutch sampatti sambhalne tatha usi hisab rakhne ke nirdesh diye gaye. Isi tarah Mr. Patrick Heatly, jo Calcutta me Revenue Accountant-General ke daftar me kaam karte the, ko Patna bhejne ka nirnay hua tatha Mr. Samuel Hasleby ko Dacca me deputy ke roop me kaam karne ke liye bheja gaya. Exam point: Edward Stephenson, Simeon Droze tatha Henry Cottrell kramashah Patna, Cassimbazar tatha Dacca ke Commercial Chiefs the; inhi stationon par Dutch factoryon ki sampatti tatha hisab sambhalne ke nirdesh bheje gaye the.

qe: What list was Mr. Heatly directed to transmit to the commissaries regarding the servants of the Dutch East India Company employed in their Patna factory?
qh: पटना की डच फैक्ट्री में कार्यरत डच ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के सेवकों के संबंध में श्री हीटली को कमिश्नरों को कौन-सी सूची भेजने का निर्देश दिया गया था?
oe: A list of their salaries and arrears
A list of their wives and children
A list of their houses and lands
A list specifying their names, stations or employments and qualities
oh: उनके वेतन तथा बकाया की सूची
उनकी पत्नियों तथा बच्चों की सूची
उनके घरों तथा ज़मीनों की सूची
उनके नाम, स्टेशन या काम तथा गुण-विवरण दर्शाने वाली सूची
e: Patna ki Dutch factory ka prabhar lene wale Mr. Patrick Heatly ko Commissaries ne vistrit nirdesh diye. Unhe kaha gaya ki Dutch Chief se in sabhi sewakon ki soochi maangein, jo Dutch East India Company ki Patna factory me kaam karte the, tatha us soochi me har sewak ka naam, station yaani karyasthal ya kaam tatha quality yaani uski shreni likhi ho. Iske saath hi unhe native Dutch Company ke sewakon ki sahayta lene ko kaha gaya, jinki soochi woh Dutch Chief se maangenge, tatha samay-samay par batate rahein ki kaam-kaj ke liye aur kaun-kaunse sewak zaroori honge. Mr. Philip Milner Dacres, jo Calcutta ke Commercial Council ke President the, se anurodh kiya gaya ki woh Mr. Samuel Hasleby ko Dacca me deputy ka kaam karne ke liye bhej dein. Exam point: Heatly ko Dutch factory ke sewakon ki aisi soochi bhejne ko kaha gaya, jisme har ek ka naam, station ya kaam tatha quality likhi ho; usse native sewakon ki sahayta bhi leni thi tatha Hasleby ko Dacca me deputy banaya gaya.

qe: In conformity with the orders of the Council in Calcutta dated the 8th July 1781, the commissaries at Chinsura supplied which officer with masts, spars, cables and the like for the equipment of his vessel?
qh: कलकत्ता की काउंसिल के 8 जुलाई 1781 के आदेशों के अनुपालन में चिनसुरा के कमिश्नरों ने किस अधिकारी को उसके जहाज़ को तैयार करने के लिए मस्तूल, स्पार तथा रस्से आदि दिए?
e: Chinsura par adhikar ke baad Commissaries ko Calcutta ki Council se vibhinn aadesh milte rahe. 8 July 1781 ke aadeshon ke anupaalan me unhonne Colonel Henry Watson ko masts yaani mastool, spars yaani jahaz ke bade lakdi ke dande, cables yaani moti rassiyan tatha aisi hi anya samagri di, jo uske jahaz ko taiyar karne ke liye zaroori thi. Aise aadesh dikhate hain ki adhikar ke baad jahaji tatha military vyavasthaon ko mazboot kiya ja raha tha tatha Dutch stationon ki sampatti tatha samagri ka upyog angrezi Company ke apne kaam ke liye kiya ja raha tha. Isi kaal me mint jaise sansthaon ki zaroorat ke liye dhatu bhi isi kshetra se bheji gayi. Exam point: Kolkata ki Council ke 8 July 1781 ke aadeshon ke anupaalan me Chinsura ke Commissioners ne Colonel Henry Watson ko uske jahaz ke liye mastool, spars tatha rassiyan di; in aadeshon se pata chalta hai ki adhikar ke baad jahaji vyavastha mazboot ki ja rahi thi.

qe: Mr. W. Paxton, Mint-Master in Calcutta, sent his sarkar Ramkanai to the commissaries at Chinsura to purchase how much Japan copper for the use of the English Company's mint?
qh: कलकत्ता के टकसाल-अधिकारी श्री डब्ल्यू. पैक्सटन ने अपने सरकार रामकनाई को चिनसुरा के कमिश्नरों के पास अंग्रेज़ कंपनी की टकसाल के लिए कितना जापानी ताँबा खरीदने भेजा था?
e: Chinsura par adhikar ke baad wahan mili dhatuon tatha samagri ka upyog angrezi Company ke apne kaam ke liye hone laga. Mr. W. Paxton, jo Calcutta me Mint-Master yaani tanke ke prabhari the, ne apne sarkar yaani karobar sambhalne wale karmachari Ramkanai ko 11 July 1781 ko Chinsura bheja, jahan se usne Company ki tanke ke liye paanch maund Japan copper yaani japani tamba kharidna tha; 13 July 1781 ko Commissaries ne Ramkanai ko utna tamba Calcutta bhejne ki anumati de di. Japani tamba apni shuddhata ke liye prasiddh tha, isliye sikka banane me uski maang thi. Is tarah Dutch godownon me rakha maal tatha unke vyapar ka hissa angrezi prabandhan apne fayde ke liye le raha tha. Exam point: Calcutta ke Mint-Master W. Paxton ke sarkar Ramkanai ko Chinsura se paanch maund Japan copper kharidne ke liye bheja gaya, jise 13 July 1781 ko Calcutta bhejne ki anumati mili; yah tamba angrezi Company ki tanke ke liye tha.

qe: On the 14th July 1781 the commissaries sent to the Council in Calcutta four chests of what, found in the Dutch factory at Chinsura?
qh: 14 जुलाई 1781 को कमिश्नरों ने चिनसुरा की डच फैक्ट्री में मिली किस चीज़ की चार संदूकें कलकत्ता की काउंसिल को भेजीं?
e: Chinsura ki Dutch factory tatha uske khazane me qeemti sampatti mili. 14 July 1781 ko Commissaries ne us factory me mili sone ki ingots yaani dhale hue sone ki chaar sandukein Calcutta ki Council ko bheji. Iske teen din baad, 17 July 1781 ko, apne saathiyon ke anurodh par Mr. Charles Purling ne Chinsura ka Dutch khazana apne prabhar me liya; us samay us khazane me 13,28,253 sicca rupees nakad the. Sicca rupee us samay ka chandi ka sikka tha, jise Company ke ilaqon me hisab-kitab ka aadhar mana jaata tha. Sone ki ingots tatha itni badi nakad raqam ka milna dikhata hai ki Chinsura ki Dutch basty me jama sampatti kitni vishal thi tatha ispar adhikar se angrezi Company ko bada laabh hua. Exam point: 14 July 1781 ko Chinsura ki Dutch factory se mili sone ki ingots ki chaar sandukein Calcutta bheji gayin tatha 17 July 1781 ko Charles Purling ne Dutch khazana apne prabhar me liya, jisme 13,28,253 sicca rupees nakad the.

qe: How many Dutch prisoners were there in Fort William in Calcutta, for whom Lieutenant P. Arnold undertook to procure the provisions?
qh: कलकत्ता के फोर्ट विलियम में कितने डच बंदी थे, जिनके लिए लेफ्टिनेंट पी. अर्नोल्ड ने रसद जुटाने का काम लिया?
e: Chinsura ki Dutch basty par adhikar ke baad wahan ke European logon ko bandi bana liya gaya tatha unme se bahut se Dutch Calcutta ke Fort William me rakhe gaye, jinki sankhya chhattis thi. Lieutenant P. Arnold ne in bandiyon ke liye rasad yaani khana-peena jutaane ka kaam liya; 14 July 1781 ko Commissaries ne unhe likha ki woh is kaam ka maasik anuman yaani monthly estimate bana kar bhejein tatha is vishay ki sabhi baaton par unse patra-vyavhar karein. Aise bandiyon ki dekh-bhal tatha kharch ka hisab rakhna bhi prabandhan ka ek mahatvapurna hissa tha. In bandiyon ki sthiti tatha unke parivaron ke vishay me aage kai baar anurodh bhi kiye gaye. Exam point: Fort William, Calcutta me chhattis Dutch bandi the, jinke liye Lieutenant P. Arnold ne rasad jutaane ka kaam liya tatha 14 July 1781 ko Commissioners ne unse maasik anuman bhejne ko kaha.

qe: The Dutch prisoners in Fort William informed Mr. J. M. Ross on the 13th July 1781 that the captain of which ship had asked them to remain in readiness for being transported on his vessel to Madras?
qh: फोर्ट विलियम के डच बंदियों ने 13 जुलाई 1781 को श्री जे. एम. रॉस को बताया कि किस जहाज़ के कप्तान ने उनसे कहा था कि वे मद्रास ले जाने के लिए तैयार रहें?
e: Fort William me rakhe Dutch bandiyon ko 13 July 1781 ko bataya gaya ki Chaser naam ke jahaz ke captain ne kaha hai ki ve apne jahaz par Madras le jaane ke liye taiyar rehain. Is baat se vyakul hokar Mr. J. M. Ross ne 14 July 1781 ko Commissaries ko ek bhavuk patra likha, jisme kaha ki in sabhi logon ke ghar, patniyan tatha bachche Chinsura me hain; yadi yah aadesh poora hua tatha ve ek saath apni sampatti tatha apne priyjanon se vanchit kar diye gaye, to unki dasha bahut kathin hogi. Usne manavta tatha apne kartavya ke aadhar par in bandiyon ke hit me anurodh kiya ki yah aadesh poora na kiya jaye tatha unhe unke parivaron ke paas rahne diya jaye. Is patra ki ek prat Commissaries ne turant Governor-General tatha Council ko bhej di. Exam point: Chaser naam ke jahaz ke captain ne Dutch bandiyon se Madras jaane ke liye taiyar rehne ko kaha tha; Mr. Ross ne 14 July 1781 ko unke parivaron ke aadhar par unhe wahin rakhne ki anurodh bhari patra likha, jise Governor-General tatha Council ko bheja gaya.

qe: Mr. Paterson took charge of the effects of the Dutch at Baranagore from which officer who commanded the detachment there?
qh: श्री पैटरसन ने बरानागोर में डचों की संपत्ति किस अधिकारी से अपने कब्जे में ली, जो वहाँ की सैन्य टुकड़ी का कमांडर था?
e: Chinsura par adhikar ke saath-saath angrezi Company ne Baranagore sthit Dutch factory par bhi adhikar kar liya. Governor-General tatha Council ke nirdesh par Committee of Revenue ne Mr. John David Paterton ko 6 July 1781 ko is kaam par lagaya ki woh Baranagore ki Dutch factory ki public tatha private dono tarah ki sampatti tatha samagri apne kabje me le. Mr. Paterson ne Baranagore me Dutch sampatti us sainik tukdi ke adhikari Sergeant Mejor Beniva se apne kabje me li, jo wahan ki tukdi ka commandar tha, tatha us samagri ki ek soochi Committee of Revenue ko bheji. Committee of Revenue ne 13 July 1781 ko Paterson ke patra ki ek prat Chinsura ke Commissaries ko bhejte hue likha ki unaes abhi ke liye sampatti apne kabje me rakhein, jab tak Commissaries kisi vyakti ko uska prabhar lene ke liye na bhej dein. Exam point: Mr. Paterson ne Baranagore me Dutch sampatti Sergeant Mejor Beniva se li, jo wahan ki sainik tukdi ka commandar tha, tatha uski soochi Committee of Revenue ko bheji; Committee ne Paterson ko kaha ki sampatti Commissaries ke aadmi aane tak apne kabje me rakhe.

qe: Which deputy, appointed on behalf of the commissaries at Chinsura for the Dutch factory at Kalikapore near Cassimbazar, received charge and possession of that factory from the acting Chief of Murshidabad on the 18th July 1781?
qh: चिनसुरा के कमिश्नरों की ओर से कासिमबाज़ार के पास कालिकापुर की डच फैक्ट्री के लिए नियुक्त उप-प्रतिनिधि ने 18 जुलाई 1781 को मुर्शिदाबाद के कार्यवाहक प्रमुख से उस फैक्ट्री का प्रभार तथा कब्ज़ा किस से लिया?
e: Chinsura ke Commissaries ne poore Bangal tatha Bihar me Dutch factoryon ka prabhar lene ke liye apne deputy niyukt kiye. Inme Mr. John Craigie ko Kalikapore ki Dutch factory ka prabhar diya gaya, jo Cassimbazar ke paas Murshidabad jile me sthit thi. Craigie ne 18 July 1781 ko us factory ka charge tatha possession apne nam kar liya tatha yah prabhar usne Murshidabad ke acting Chief yaani karyavahak pramukh se liya. Usi din usne Commissaries ko is baat ki soochna di tatha bataya ki woh unke aadeshon ko shighra hi poora karne ke liye aage badhega. Is tarah Patna, Cassimbazar tatha Dacca ke stationon par ek vyavasthit roop se Dutch sampatti ka prabhar angrezi adhikariyon ke haath me chala gaya. Exam point: Mr. John Craigie ko Kalikapore (Cassimbazar ke paas, Murshidabad jile) ki Dutch factory ka prabhar mila, jo usne 18 July 1781 ko Murshidabad ke acting Chief se liya tatha usi din Commissaries ko soochit kiya; woh aadeshon ko shighra poora karne ke liye taiyar tha.

qe: Under the settlement after the peace of 1783-84, the Council in Calcutta agreed to restore to the Dutch their warehouses and factories at Chinsura, Cassimbazar and which other place, permitting them to establish their own laws and regulations?
qh: 1783-84 की शांति-व्यवस्था के बाद कलकत्ता की काउंसिल ने डचों को चिनसुरा, कासिमबाज़ार तथा किस अन्य स्थान की कोठियाँ तथा फैक्ट्रियाँ लौटाने और वहाँ अपने क़ानून-नियम बनाने की अनुमति देने पर सहमति दी?
e: 1783 me Versailles me England tatha France ke beech shaanti tatha maitri ki sandhi hui, jiske baad England tatha Holland ke beech bhi aisi hi sandhi hui; in sandhiyon me tay hua ki dono paksh ek doosre ki jite hue ilaqon ko wapas kar denge. Iske aadhar par Calcutta ki Council ne tay kiya ki Chinsura, Cassimbazar tatha Patna me Dutch logon ki godown tatha factory unhe wapas kar di jaayengi tatha unhe vahan apne kabile yaani vidhi-kayde aur niyam banane ki anumati di jaayegi. Is anumati par ek shart thi - woh Chinsura me apna jhanda nahi phahra sakte the tatha na vahan sainik ya sainik samagri la sakte the; yah tab tak nahi ho sakta tha, jab tak Marquis de Bussy ki or se poorn lakhit sandhi ka palan hone ki khabar na aa jaye. Is tarah Patna ki Dutch factory bhi wapas milne wali sansthaon me shamil thi. Exam point: 1783-84 ki shaanti sandhiyon ke baad Calcutta Council ne Chinsura, Cassimbazar tatha Patna me Dutch godown tatha factory wapas karne tatha unhe apne niyam-chalane ki anumati dene ka tay kiya; lekin Chinsura me jhanda phahrane tatha sainik samagri lane par rok thi.

qe: The Calcutta Council thanked the Dutch at Batavia for permitting a supply of which article to be sent from Batavia for the relief of the Carnatic, carried in the ship Vansittart?
qh: कलकत्ता की काउंसिल ने बटाविया के डचों को किस वस्तु की आपूर्ति की अनुमति देने के लिए धन्यवाद दिया, जो वैनसिटार्ट जहाज़ से कर्नाटक की राहत के लिए भेजी गई थी?
e: 1783-84 ki sandhiyon ke baad angrezi tatha Dutch Company ke adhikariyon ke sambandh poore saumyas yaani harmonius nahi ho gaye the, lekin madad ka aadan-pradan shuru ho gaya tha. Calcutta ki Council ne Batavia ki Council ko likhe patra me bataya ki 15 December 1783 ke apne patra me ki gayi prarthana par unki Council ne Carnatic yaani dakshin Bharat ke prabhavit ilaqe ki rahat ke liye Batavia se chawal bhejne ki anumati di thi, jise Vansittart jahaz par bheja gaya. Is sahayta ka mahatva aur badh gaya, kyunki us samay Batavia ke logon ki khud ki zarooratein bhi kam nahi thin. Fort St. George se soochna mili ki chawal ke saath koi invoice mand nahi tha, lekin Madras me utre hue chawal ka hisab bhej diya gaya; us raqam ka bhugtan kuch nakad tatha kuch shora dekar karne ka prayas tha. Exam point: Batavia ke Dutchon ne 15 December 1783 ki prarthana par Carnatic ki rahat ke liye chawal bhejne ki anumati di, jo Vansittart jahaz se pahunchi; Calcutta Council ne is sahayta ke liye unhe dhanyavad diya tatha bhugtan kuch nakad tatha kuch shora me karne ki baat kahi.

qe: Which officer was deputed by the Calcutta Committee of Revenue in December 1777 to ascertain the extent and value of the town and environs of Baranagore and of the land near Hugli offered in exchange?
qh: कलकत्ता की कमेटी ऑफ़ रेवेन्यू ने दिसंबर 1777 में किस अधिकारी को बरानागोर के नगर तथा उसके परिवेश तथा बदले में दी जाने वाली हुगली के पास की भूमि का विस्तार तथा मूल्य जानने के लिए नियुक्त किया?
e: Dutch logon ne apni Baranagore basty ko, jo Calcutta se lagbhag chhah mile uttar me ek purani tatha mahatvapurna basty thi, Hugli ke paas ki zameen ke badle angrezi Company ko dene ka prastav rakha tha; is prastav ka vistrit ullekh Dutchon ke April 1775 ke memorial me tha. Warren Hastings ki sarkar ne is badle ke saude ko dono pakshon ke liye laabhdayak maankar svikar kiya, isliye Calcutta ki Committee of Revenue ne December 1777 me Mr. Perring ko niyukt kiya ki woh Baranagore ke nagar tatha uske aas-paas ke ilaqe tatha Hugli ke paas ki us zameen ka vistaar tatha mulya pata karein, jo Dutch log badle me lena chahte the. Mr. Perring ne 30 April 1778 ko apni report di. Uske aadhar par yah tay hua ki Baranagore ki Dutch sampatti ka Sudder Jumma yaani saalana shudh lagan 1,961 sicca rupees 13 aane tha tatha Hugli ke paas ki zameen ka 3,938 rupees 1 aana 3 paise; usme se Sayer yaani chhote-chhote vasooliyon ka ke 1,200 rupees 15 aane 10 paise ghatane ke baad Hugli wali zameen ki shudh aay 2,737 rupees 9 aane thi, jo Baranagore se 715 rupees 12 aane adhik thi. Exam point: Baranagore ke badle ki zameen ka mulya jaanne ke liye December 1777 me Committee of Revenue ne Mr. Perring ko niyukt kiya, jinhone 30 April 1778 ko report di; Hugli ke paas ki zameen ki shudh aay Baranagore se 715 rupees 12 aane adhik nikli thi.

qe: The Dutch factory at which place remained in the possession of the English from its capture in 1781 till January 1786, after which its agent Mr. Lawrence D'Costa complained against the English Resident?
qh: किस स्थान की डच फैक्ट्री 1781 में अंग्रेज़ों द्वारा अधिकार किए जाने के बाद जनवरी 1786 तक अंग्रेज़ों के कब्ज़े में रही, जिसके बाद उसके एजेंट श्री लॉरेंस डी'कोस्टा ने अंग्रेज़ रेज़िडेंट के विरुद्ध शिकायत की?
e: 1783-84 ki shaanti ke baad bhi angrezi tatha Dutch Company ke adhikariyon ke sambandh poori tarah saumyas nahi ho paaye the tatha Dutchon ko unki saari bastiyan turant wapas nahi mili thin. Balasore sthit Dutch factory 1781 me uspar adhikar hone ke baad se January 1786 tak angrezi kabje me hi rahi. Iske baad Dutch factory ke agent Mr. Lawrence D'Costa ne Chinsura ki Council ke Governor Isaac Titsingh ko 23 October 1787 tatha 10 October 1788 ko do patra likhe, jinme unhonne Balasore ki angrezi factory ke Resident Mr. Wordsworth ke viruddh shikayat ki. Unki shikayat thi ki Wordsworth unke kauriyon yaani chhoti chamkeeli sipiyon ke vyapar me rukavatein daal rahe the, jise ve Balasore bandargah par aane wale Maldiv yaani Maldives ke vyapariyon ke saath karte the; sath hi unhonne Dutch sewakon tatha ashriton ke saath kharab vyavhar ki bhi shikayat ki. Exam point: Balasore ki Dutch factory 1781 se January 1786 tak angrezi kabje me rahi; iske baad Dutch agent Lawrence D'Costa ne 1787-88 me angrezi Resident Wordsworth ke viruddh Maldiv vyapariyon ke saath kauriyon ke vyapar me rukavat tatha sewakon ke saath kharab vyavhar ki shikayat ki.

qe: Governor Titsingh forwarded the Balasore complaints to which Governor-General, who placed them before the Council on 12 January 1789 and proposed that copies be sent to Mr. Wordsworth?
qh: गवर्नर टिटसिंघ ने बालासोर की शिकायतें किस गवर्नर-जनरल को भेजीं, जिन्होंने 12 जनवरी 1789 को उन्हें काउंसिल के सामने रखा तथा श्री वर्ड्सवर्थ को प्रतियाँ भेजने का प्रस्ताव रखा?
e: Balasore ke Dutch agent Mr. Lawrence D'Costa ki shikayaton ko Chinsura ke Governor Isaac Titsingh ne Calcutta ke Governor-General Lord Cornwallis ko bheja. Cornwallis ne 12 January 1789 ko in patron ko Calcutta ki Council ke sadasyaon ke samne vichar ke liye rakha tatha prastav rakha ki in patron ki pratilipi Mr. Wordsworth ko un nirdeshon ke saath bheji jaye ki woh cowries yaani sipiyon ke us vyapar ki prakriti Council ko batayein, jiski vajah se un aur Dutch agent ke beech matbhed paida hue the, tatha un par lagi hinsa sambandhi aaropon ka jawab dein. Council ne 12 January 1789 ko Titsingh ko likha ki Wordsworth ke jawab aane par vah shikayaton par vichar karegi. Council ka yah vyavhar England tatha Netherlands ke sambandhon ke saath mel khata tha, khaasakar 1788 ke Triple Alliance ke baad, jisme England, Prussia tatha Holland shamil the tatha April 1788 me Anglo-Dutch raksha sandhi bhi hui thi. Exam point: Titsingh ne D'Costa ki shikayatein Governor-General Lord Cornwallis ko bhejin, jinhonne 12 January 1789 ko unhe Council ke samne rakha; Council ne Wordsworth se jawab maangne ka tay kiya, jo 1788 ke Triple Alliance tatha Anglo-Dutch raksha sandhi ke samay sambandhon ke anukool tha.

qe: Under the proposals for exchanging Baranagore, the Dutch were to pay a lump sum equal to ten years' purchase for the surplus lands; that amount came to how much?
qh: बारानगर की अदला-बदली के प्रस्तावों में डचों को अधिशेष भूमि के लिए दस वर्ष की खरीद के बराबर एकमुश्त राशि देनी थी, जो कितनी बनती थी?
e: Baranagore yaani Baranagar Calcutta ke paas ek Dutch basti thi, jiski zameen par Dutch Company ka apna adhikar chalta tha. Angrezi Company ki Calcutta sarkar chahti thi ki is basti ke badle Hughli ke paas ki zameenein apne adhikar me kar lein, kyunki ek videshi adhikar ke andar basi hui jagah Calcutta ke liye pareshani ban rahi thi. Prastav do roopon me tha. Pehla, Baranagore ke mulya ke barabar zameen ka ek nishchit hissa Dutch ko diya jaye. Dusra, poori zameen ek saath de di jaye, jiske liye Dutch ko ten years purchase yaani dus saal ki aamdani ke barabar ekamushth rakam deni hogi; yah rakam 1,758 rupaye banti thi. Iske badle woh sarkar ko settlement yaani tay lagan ke barabar saalana raqam bhi de sakte the. Ten years purchase ka matlab hai ki jis zameen ki saalana aamdani hai, uske das guna ke barabar paisa ek hi baar me chukana. Exam point: Baranagore ke badle zameen ke liye Dutch ke saamne 1,758 rupaye ekamushth, ya barabar saalana lagan, dene ka prastav rakha gaya tha.

qe: What ground did the Dutch Council at Chinsura give for abruptly breaking off the negotiations for the exchange of Baranagore?
qh: चिनसुरा की डच काउंसिल ने बारानगर की अदला-बदली की बातचीत अचानक किस आधार पर बंद कर दी?
oe: That their authorities at Batavia had not given final sanction to the measure
That the price offered was far too high
That the lands near Hughli were unproductive
That the English had failed to pay the annual rent
oh: कि बटाविया के उनके अधिकारियों ने इस कदम को अंतिम स्वीकृति नहीं दी थी
कि पेश की गई कीमत बहुत अधिक थी
कि हुगली के पास की भूमि अनुत्पादक थी
कि अंग्रेजों ने वार्षिक लगान नहीं चुकाया था
e: Baranagore ke badle zameen lene ki baat 1789 me Lord Cornwallis aur Chinsura ke Dutch Director Isaac Titsingh ke beech aage badhi. Hukumat ki taraf se prastav rakha gaya ki Baranagore ke badle Hughli ke paas ki zameenein di jayein. Lekin thik usi samay Chinsura ki Dutch Council ne yah kehte hue baatcheet achanak band kar di ki Batavia ke unke adhikariyon ne is kadam ko antim svikriti yaani final sanction nahi di thi. Batavia aaj ke Jakarta ke aas-paas Dutch Company ka bada mukhyaalay tha, aur Chinsura ke Dutch log usi ke adhin the, isliye bina Batavia ki manzoori ke woh koi bada nirnay nahi le sakte the. Is tarah dono pakshon ke liye labhdayak prastav sirf isi kaaran latak gaya. Exam point: Chinsura ki Dutch Council ne Baranagore ki adla-badli ki baatcheet is aadhar par band kar di, yeh kehte hue ki Batavia ke adhikariyon ne final sanction yaani antim svikriti nahi di thi.

qe: After the Convention of 1814, who was appointed Commissioner at Chinsura to take back possession of the settlements of the King of the Netherlands in India?
qh: 1814 की संधि के बाद चिनसुरा में आयुक्त किसे नियुक्त किया गया था, जिसे भारत में नीदरलैंड के राजा की बस्तियों का पुनः कब्ज़ा लेना था?
e: 1814 ki Convention ke baad Dutch bastiyon ko wapas lene ki prakriya shuru hui. Isi ke tehat Mr. F. A. Van Braam ko Chinsura ka Commissioner niyukta kiya gaya, jiska kaam Bharat me Netherlands ke Raja ki sabhi bastiyon ka punah kabza lena tha. Unhone 1817 me Mr. Cassiarees Regal ko Patna aur Dacca ki Dutch establishments ka charge lene ke liye bheja, aur agle saal tak Dutch ko Cochin aur Baranagore ke apvad ke saath unki sabhi Bharat sthit sampattiyan wapas mil gayin. Yaad rakhein ki Cochin aur Baranagore is samjhauta se bahar rakhe gaye the, isliye wahan Dutch ka shasan dobara shuru nahi hua. Exam point: 1814 ki Convention ke baad Chinsura me Mr. F. A. Van Braam Commissioner niyukta hue, jinhone Dutch bastiyon ka punah kabza lene ki prakriya chalaayi.

qe: Who was deputed in July 1795 to take possession of the Dutch settlement of Chinsura, with the help of a military force if necessary?
qh: जुलाई 1795 में चिनसुरा की डच बस्ती पर कब्ज़ा करने के लिए किसे भेजा गया था, जिसे ज़रूरत पड़ने पर सैन्य बल लेने का अधिकार था?
e: 1794-95 me France ne Holland par kabza kiya, January 1795 me Amsterdam par bhi adhikar ho gaya aur Stadholder England bhaag gaya. Iske baad Angrezi hukumat ne Dutch bastiyon ko apne adhikar me lene ka nirnay kiya. Dutch niwasiyon se kaha gaya ki jahan tak unka andaruni prabandh hai, Angrezi sarkar usme dakhal nahi degi; sirf ek chhota sa guard Chinsura me British jhande ki suraksha ke liye chhoda jayega. Isi ke tehat July 1795 me Mr. Bitch ko Chinsura par kabza karne ke liye bheja gaya, aur zarurat pade to sainik bal lene ki chhoot di gayi. Unko hidaayat di gayi ki kisi niwasi par koi zulm na ho aur kisi ki sampatti ko chhua na jaye. Exam point: July 1795 me Chinsura ki Dutch basti par kabze ke liye Mr. Bitch ko bheja gaya tha, jise zarurat par sainik sahayta lene ki chhoot thi.

qe: Which officer was ordered on 14 August 1795 to occupy the Dutch factory at Patna and was allowed to take military help from the Commanding Officer at Dinapore if resisted?
qh: 14 अगस्त 1795 को पटना की डच फैक्ट्री पर कब्ज़े का आदेश किस अधिकारी को दिया गया था, जिसे विरोध होने पर दीनापुर के कमांडिंग ऑफिसर से सैन्य सहायता लेने की छूट थी?
oe: Mr. Isaac Titsingh, the Dutch Director at Chinsura
Mr. Bitch, the officer sent to Chinsura
Mr. H. Douglas, the Judge and Magistrate of Patna
oh: मिस्टर आइज़क टिटसिंघ, चिनसुरा के डच डायरेक्टर
मिस्टर बिच, चिनसुरा भेजे गए अधिकारी
मिस्टर एच. डगलस, पटना के जज और मजिस्ट्रेट
e: 1795 me Angrezi hukumat ne Patna ki Dutch factory par bhi kabza karne ka nirnay kiya. Factory ka matlab hai Company ka vyapaarik thikana ya kothi, jahan se vyapar chalaya jata tha. 14 August 1795 ko Patna ke Judge aur Magistrate Mr. H. Douglas ko aadesh diya gaya ki woh Patna ki Dutch factory par kabza kar lein. Agar Dutch adhikari virodh karein to unhe Dinapore ke Commanding Officer se sainik sahayta lene ki chhoot thi. Douglas ko saath hi kaha gaya ki woh Dutch niwasiyon ke saath poora samman aur dayaluta rakhein, unke kanoon aur reet-riwajon me dakhal na dein, un par koi naya tax ya duty na lagayein, tatha unhe Angrezi Company ke thikaanon se vyapar ki wahi suvidhayein dein jo Angrezi niwasiyon ko milti hain. Exam point: Patna ki Dutch factory par kabze ka aadesh 14 August 1795 ko Patna ke Judge aur Magistrate Mr. H. Douglas ko diya gaya tha, jise Dinapore se sainik madad lene ki chhoot thi.

qe: Which British officer met the Dutch fleet at the Cape of Good Hope and forced it to surrender, freeing the Government of India from the fear of a French and Dutch naval combination?
qh: किस ब्रिटिश अधिकारी ने केप ऑफ गुड होप पर डच बेड़े को घेर कर आत्मसमर्पण के लिए विवश किया, जिससे भारत की सरकार फ्रांसीसी-डच नौसैनिक गठजोड़ के भय से मुक्त हो गई?
e: 1795 ke aas-paas France aur Holland ka mila jula bal Angrezi Company ke liye bada bhayankar ban gaya. Ek khabar ne Calcutta me khauf paida kar diya ki ek shaktishali Dutch fleet samundar me aa gayi hai jo French ke saath mil kar Angrezi hukumat ke khilaf kaam karegi. Is ashanka ka ant tab hua jab Sir George Keith Elphinstone ne Cape of Good Hope ke paas Dutch fleet ko gher kar samarpan ke liye vivash kar diya. Isse Government of India nirbhay ho gayi, kyunki samundar ki taraf se aane wala khatra khatam ho gaya.
