Yah ghatna dikhati hai ki Europe ke yudh ka asar seedha Bharat me Angrezi aur Dutch sambandhon par pad raha tha, aur isi kaaran Angrezi hukumat ne Dutch bastiyon ko apne adhikar me lena zaruri samjha. Exam point: Sir George Keith Elphinstone ne Cape of Good Hope ke paas Dutch fleet ko samarpan ke liye vivash kiya, jisse Bharat ki sarkar ka samudri bhaya samapt hua.

qe: After the Peace of Amiens in 1802, Lord Wellesley was ordered to give back to the French and the Batavian Republic all their settlements in India, excepting which?
qh: 1802 की पीस ऑफ एमियंस के बाद लॉर्ड वेलेज़ली को आदेश मिला कि फ्रांस और बटावियन रिपब्लिक की भारत की सभी बस्तियाँ लौटा दी जाएँ, सिवाय किसके?
e: 27 March 1802 ki Peace of Amiens me tay hua ki England apni jit ki jagahon me se sirf Ceylon aur Trinidad apne paas rakhega, baaki sab France ya uske sahyogiyon ko lauta diya jayega. Isi ke mutabik Lord Wellesley ko England ki hukumat se aadesh mile ki woh French aur Batavian Republic ki Bharat ki sabhi bastiyan wapas kar de, sirf Ceylon ke Dutch bandargah apvad rahenge. Lekin Europe me Napoleon ki shakti phir badhne lagi aur yah shaanti zyada din nahi chali, isliye Bharat me Angrezi-Dutch tatha Angrezi-French sambandh phir tanav bhare hue rahe. Batavian Republic France par nirbhar sarkar thi, jo Holland me 1795 ke baad bani thi aur jiske naam par Dutch East India Company ka kaam bhi ab France ke prabhav me chal raha tha. Exam point: Peace of Amiens ke baad Wellesley ko aadesh mila ki French aur Batavian Republic ki sabhi Bharat sthit bastiyan lauta di jayein, sirf Ceylon ke Dutch bandargah chhod kar.

qe: In February 1795 the fugitive Stadholder issued a circular asking his late subjects to place their colonies under the protection of which power?
qh: फरवरी 1795 में भागे हुए स्टैडहोल्डर ने एक परिपत्र निकालकर अपने पुराने प्रजाजनों से कहा कि वे अपने उपनिवेश किस शक्ति की सुरक्षा में रख दें?
e: Stadholder Holland ke Dutch Republic ka vanshanugat sarvochch pramukh hota tha. 1794 me French sena ne Holland par poora kabza kar liya aur January 1795 me Amsterdam par bhi adhikar kar liya. Stadholder England bhaag gaya aur Holland me France ke adhin ek nayi sarkar Batavian Republic ban gayi. Is sthiti me February 1795 me us bhaage hue rajkumar ne ek circular jaari kiya, jisme apne purane prajaon se kaha ki woh apni colonies Great Britain ki suraksha me rakh dein. Iske baad Angrezi hukumat ne ek proclamation nikaal kar Dutch bastiyon ko bataya ki unhe Angrezi bastiyon ke barabar suvidhayein aur suraksha milegi. Is tarah Bharat me bhi 1795 me Dutch bastiyon ka prabandh British adhikar me aa gaya. Exam point: February 1795 me bhaage hue Stadholder ne circular jaari kar apne purane prajaon se kaha ki woh apni colonies Great Britain ki suraksha me rakh dein.

qe: When the English took possession of Chinsura in 1795, a small guard was left there for the protection of what?
qh: 1795 में जब अंग्रेजों ने चिनसुरा पर कब्ज़ा किया, तब वहाँ एक छोटा सा पहरा किसकी सुरक्षा के लिए छोड़ा गया था?
e: 1795 me Angrezi hukumat ne Dutch basti Chinsura par kabza kiya. Is samay saaf ghoshna ki gayi ki Angrezi sarkar ka iraada Dutch ke andaruni prabandh me dakhal dene ka nahi hai; sirf ek chhota sa guard Chinsura me chhoda jayega jo British jhande ki suraksha karega. Iske saath hi Dutch niwasiyon ko bharosa dilaya gaya ki unke kanoon aur reet-riwajon ko chheda nahi jayega, un par koi naya tax ya duty nahi lagaya jayega, aur woh Angrezi Company ke thikaanon se vyapar ki wahi suvidhayein paayenge jo Angrezi niwasiyon ko milti hain. Is niti se Angrezi hukumat ne Dutch niwasiyon ko apne khilaf bhadkane se bachaya aur unka vyapar bhi bilkul band nahi hone diya. Exam point: Chinsura me chhota guard British jhande ki suraksha ke liye chhoda gaya tha, tatha Dutch niwasiyon ke kanoon, riwaj aur vyapar ki suvidhayein bani rahin.

qe: What did Lord Cornwallis see as the chief political objection to Baranagore remaining under Dutch jurisdiction?
qh: बारानगर के डच अधिकार क्षेत्र में बने रहने पर लॉर्ड कॉर्नवॉलिस ने मुख्य राजनीतिक आपत्ति क्या बताई?
oe: Being close to Calcutta and under a foreign flag, it gave shelter to disorderly people
It blocked the navigation of the Hughli for English ships
It supplied arms and money to the French
It collected illegal tolls from pilgrims
oh: कलकत्ता के पास और विदेशी झंडे के नीचे होने के कारण वहाँ बिगड़े लोगों को शरण मिलती थी
यह अंग्रेजी जहाज़ों के लिए हुगली की नौकायन रोकता था
यह फ्रांस को हथियार और धन पहुँचाता था
यह तीर्थयात्रियों से अवैध टोल वसूलता था
e: Baranagore Calcutta ke bilkul paas tha, lekin uska prabandh Dutch Company ke haath me tha, yaani ek videshi adhikar ke andar basi hui jagah thi. 12 January 1789 ko Calcutta ki Council me Lord Cornwallis ne saaf kaha ki Baranagore ke badle zameen lena Angrezi Company ke liye har tarah se labhdayak hai. Iske do kaaran the - pehla, yah jagah Calcutta ke paas hote hue bhi ek videshi adhikar me thi, jisse bigade hue log wahan sharan le lete the; dusra, agar Dutch ne wahan bhi Chinsura jaisi apni rashtriya chhootein chalani shuru kar di, to Angrezi hukumat ke liye bade rajniti kathinaiyan khadi ho jatin. Isi soch ke tehat Cornwallis ne Dutch Director Titsingh ke prastav ko sweekar karne ka sujhav diya. Exam point: Cornwallis ne Baranagore ka mukhya rajniti dosh yah bataya ki Calcutta ke paas hote hue ek videshi adhikar ki jagah hone ke kaaran wahan bigade hue log sharan paate the.

qe: The treaty of 17 March 1824 with the Netherlands, by which the Dutch gave up all their establishments on the continent of India, was concluded during the administration of which Governor-General?
qh: 17 मार्च 1824 की वह नीदरलैंड-संधि, जिसके द्वारा डचों ने भारत-महाद्वीप की सभी बस्तियाँ छोड़ दीं, किस गवर्नर-जनरल के कार्यकाल में हुई थी?
e: 1814 ki Convention ke baad Dutch ko unki zyadatar Bharat sthit bastiyan wapas mil gayin, lekin Angrezi aur Dutch hukumat ke beech Malacca, Singapore, Sumatra aur Java ke vyapar-adhikaron ko lekar naye matbhed khade ho gaye. Isi vajah se 17 March 1824 ko London me ek nayi treaty hui, jisme dono pakshon ne East Indies me apni-apni bastiyon ka aapsi adaan-pradan kiya. Yah samjhauta Lord Amherst ke Governor-General ke pad ke dauran hua, aur isi treaty ke tehat Dutch ne Bharat-mahadweep ki sabhi establishments chhod diye tatha unse milne wali sabhi vyaparik chhootein bhi chhod din. Is tarah Bharat me Dutch rajniti ka ant ho gaya aur unka pura dhyan Malay Archipelago me lag gaya. Exam point: 17 March 1824 ki Anglo-Dutch treaty Lord Amherst ke karyakal me hui, jisme Dutch ne Bharat-mahadweep ki sabhi establishments chhod diye.

qe: The exchange of Baranagore for lands in the neighbourhood of Hughli is believed to have been finally carried out in which year?
qh: हुगली के आसपास की भूमि के बदले बारानगर की अदला-बदली अंततः किस वर्ष पूरी हुई मानी जाती है?
e: Baranagore ke badle Hughli ke paas zameen lene ka prastav sabse pehle April 1775 ke Dutch Memorial me aaya tha. 1789 me Lord Cornwallis ke samay Chinsura ke Director Isaac Titsingh ne is baat ko dobara uthaya, lekin Batavia se antim svikriti na milne ke kaaran baatcheet toot gayi. Iske baad 1795 me yah adla-badli aakhirkaar antim roop le gayi, isliye mani jaata hai ki Baranagore ka Hathiyantaran 1795 me hua. Iske baad Dutch ka dhyan Chinsura par hi raha, aur 1814 ki Convention me Cochin aur Baranagore ko apvad bana kar unhe Dutch ko wapas na dene ka nirnay hua. Exam point: Baranagore aur Hughli ke paas ki zameen ki adla-badli 1795 me antim roop me poori hui mani jaati hai.
